Communicate with caregivers and agencies

Keep everything organized and compliant



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE (Do NOT apply if you don’t have this)

Experience with Availity

Experience with HHAeXchange

Worked with US healthcare billing (Medicaid or insurance)

Used clearinghouses (Waystar, Office Ally, Change Healthcare, etc.)

Understand claim rejections, modifiers, and authorizations



(Preferred)

Home care / home health experience

Michigan Medicaid, Aetna, Molina, or WellCare experience

EHR systems (CareTime, AxisCare, AlayaCare, etc.)

EVV compliance experience (especially live-in caregivers)



Work Details

Remote, long-term position

Pay based on experience:

$5–$6/hour to start (training/trial period)

Increase to $6–$8/hour after 30 days based on performance



HOW TO APPLY 

Put the word CLAIMS in your subject line or application title

Please include a 2–3 minute video answering the questions below.

Applications without a video will not be reviewed.

Introduce yourself + your healthcare experience

What systems have you used? (Availity, HHAeXchange, EHRs, clearinghouses)

Explain how you fix a denied or rejected claim (your actual process)

What experience do you have with EVV / caregiver clock-in & out issues?

What are your working hours and internet speed?



Bonus: Share your screen and show a system you’ve used (if possible)

We’re looking for a capable Social Media VA to support the digital presence of a high-end Australian residential construction business. Your main focus is the social side — content creation, editing, scheduling, and producing company process documents.



This is a part-time, remote role — around two days per week (subject to change depending on your capabilities).



What You’ll Be Doing



Content & Social (your main focus)

- Creating, editing, and scheduling content across Instagram,
 and

- Designing branded Canva graphics, sales materials, and company process documents

- Executing the content calendar and repurposing long-form content (blogs, videos, notes) into social-ready formats

- Maintaining a consistent, clean, high-end brand feel across every post

- Working with the team to extract the key 
nts worth showcasing



Website & Support

- Uploading and formatting blog posts in WordPress

- Updating images, text, and basic page content

- Assisting with light SEO tracking and improvements (AIOSEO, RankMath, or Semrush)

- Keeping content consistent across all platforms



We’d Love to Hear From You If You Have:

- 3+ years’ experience as a Social Media VA

- Experience managing or supporting social media accounts for service-based businesses (plus with Construction experience)

- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail

- Confidence executing content plans independently

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

- A proactive mindset — you don’t wait to be chased

- Experience working remotely with clear accountability

- Experience with GoHighLevel, or a similar CRM / marketing automation platform

- With creative flair



Nice to Have

- Adobe Suite (Photoshop, InDesign, Premiere Pro, or Illustrator)

- Experience in construction, architecture, or property

- Exposure to Google Ads or paid media support

- Able to turn rough, unstructured input into polished, engaging content

- Open to feedback and multiple rounds of revision to hit brand standards

- Someone who wants to be part of a small team long-term, not just complete tasks project-by-project



Why Join Locspec

We are a small, quality-focused team building genuinely beautiful homes — and we care just as much about how that work is told as how it’s built. The right person won’t just push out posts; they’ll help shape how Locspec shows up to the world.



Step into a role that grows as you do, with real long-term potential for the right person



We want someone with the eye, the intuition, and the drive to own this and make it better. If you’ve got what it takes — and you genuinely care about doing great work alongside people who do too — we’d love to hear from you.



To Apply 



Please send:

- Your resume

- A portfolio or links to past work



Please include the word “Process” at the top of your application so we know you’ve read the full role.

title: Media Strategist
description:
About the Role

We're looking for an experienced Media Strategist to take the lead on paid media and campaign strategy for a New Zealand-based creative business in the health and beauty space, working across multiple brands.



This is a dedicated, strategy-focused role — not a content-production one. You'll be the strategic brain behind the campaigns: shaping direction, reviewing content produced by the content creator, and making sure every brand has a clear, fresh, forward-looking plan. There's already a content creator on the team, so your focus is strategy, feedback, and results.



It's a part-time contract role with genuinely flexible hours. Some weeks are lighter than others (think 6–10 hours), so we're after someone who values a flexible, ongoing arrangement rather than full-time work. Because you'll be collaborating closely with a New Zealand-based team, you'll need to be available for communication during NZ business hours.



What You'll Be Doing

- Building and owning the paid media and campaign strategy across multiple brands

- Reviewing content created by the content creator and giving clear, constructive feedback and suggestions

- Helping move the team towards planning content and campaigns further in advance — with the goal of batching roughly three months ahead so nothing goes stale

- Continuously refining each brand's strategy, bringing fresh ideas and improvements

- Managing and optimising paid campaigns across Meta Ads and Google Ads

- Building reports that show what's working, what isn't, and what to do next

- Working as a fully integrated part of the team



What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

- You're fully integrated with the team and across each brand

- Each brand has a clear, well-built strategy with continuous improvements — no stale ideas or content

- The team is working towards batching content and campaigns around three months in advance



What We're Looking For



Must-haves

- Strong attention to detail, with the ability to optimise campaigns on a tight budget and within a small location radius

- 5+ years in a strategy role working with Meta Ads

- Strong paid media experience

- Proven campaign management experience

- Experience building content and campaign plans around three months in advance

- Hands-on experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads

- Availability during New Zealand business hours for communication



Nice-to-haves

- Experience working with New Zealand clients

- Experience in an agency setting managing multiple accounts

- Familiarity with the health and beauty industry

title: Amazon FBA Operations Specialist — Product Listings, Optimization & PPC
description:
About Us

We are a cross-border e-commerce brand managing Amazon stores in Canada and Australia, across multiple product categories: home goods, outdoor gear, electronics, pet supplies, personal care, baby & maternity, and toys. We are looking for a detail-oriented, hands-on Amazon operations specialist to join us as a long-term remote team member.



What You'll Do

This is a daily operations role, not a strategy-only position. You'll be the person actually working inside Seller Central every day.



Product Listing & Catalog Management

Create new product listings on Amazon CA and AU (flat files, manual upload, or bulk upload)

Write and optimize product titles, bullet points, and descriptions for SEO and conversion

Upload and manage A+ Content / Enhanced Brand Content pages

Research and implement backend search terms using tools like Helium 10 or Jungle Scout

Set up variations (size, color, multi-pack), pricing rules, and inventory tracking

Maintain listing quality — fix suppressed listings, flagged content, missing info, and image issues

Keep all listings aligned with Amazon's style guides and category requirements

Listing & Store Optimization

Audit existing listings and identify improvement opportunities (title, images, keywords, A+ Content)

Track keyword rankings and organic position changes; update listings accordingly

Monitor competitor listings for pricing, offers, and content changes

Manage product images — coordinate image edits, ensure compliance with Amazon image standards

Maintain brand storefront pages and category navigation

PPC & Advertising Management

Set up and manage Sponsored Products campaigns (auto, manual, broad/phrase/exact)

Set up and manage Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display campaigns

Daily bid management, keyword harvesting from search term reports, negative keyword additions

Monitor ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, and CTR; adjust campaigns to hit profitability targets

Weekly PPC performance reports with clear action items

Suggest budget reallocation based on campaign performance

Inventory & Account Support

Monitor inventory levels and coordinate FBA restock shipments

Track account health metrics, policy compliance, and performance notifications

Respond to basic customer messages and manage return/refund situations

File reimbursement claims for lost or damaged FBA inventory when needed

Tools You Should Know

Amazon Seller Central (must-have — daily use)

Helium 10 or Jungle Scout (keyword research, listing optimization)

Amazon PPC Campaign Manager (hands-on campaign building, not just dashboards)

Google Sheets / Excel (reports, tracking sheets, bulk upload templates)

Canva or basic image editing (listing images, A+ Content graphics)

Slack or WhatsApp (daily team communication)

Ideal Candidate

Amazon experience is required — you've actually worked inside Seller Central, managed listings, and run PPC campaigns. Please do not apply if you've only done Amazon-related courses or theory.

Hands-on with PPC — you know how to structure campaigns, harvest keywords, add negatives, and read search term reports. You understand ACOS vs TACOS.

Detail-obsessed — you notice a missing bullet point, a blurry image, a broken variation, or a keyword that should be negative-matched. You check your own work.

Self-driven — you don't wait to be told what to do. If a listing got suppressed, you fix it. If a campaign ACOS spiked, you investigate and adjust before being asked.

Clear communicator — you can write a short daily or weekly update that tells us what you did, what changed, and what needs attention. Fluent written English is a must.

Reliable internet and workspace — this is a remote role with real responsibilities. Consistent availability matters.

Bonus (Nice to Have)

Experience with Amazon Canada or Australia marketplace specifics

Experience with multi-marketplace management (CA + AU simultaneously)

Experience managing brand registry / brand storefront

Familiarity with Amazon reimbursement claim process

Experience with Walmart.com or other secondary marketplaces

Work Arrangement

Part-time to start, aiming for long-term ongoing partnership

15–30 hours per week (we'll start with a trial period and scale up)

Remote — work from anywhere (our team operates on GMT+8 / Asia-Pacific timezone)

Overlap of at least 3–4 hours with GMT+8 working hours is preferred

Weekly check-in call + daily async updates via Slack

Compensation

Competitive hourly rate or fixed monthly retainer — based on your experience and skills

Payment via platform escrow, Wise, or PayPal (we're flexible)

Bonuses for hitting performance targets (ACOS goals, listing quality scores, etc.)

How to Apply

Please send your proposal with the following — incomplete applications will be skipped:



A brief intro about your Amazon experience: How long have you worked with Amazon? Which marketplaces? What kinds of tasks have you handled daily?

Specific examples:

A listing you optimized — what did you change, and what improved (ranking, sales, CVR)?

A PPC campaign you managed — what was the ACOS before and after your work?

Tools you're proficient in: List the tools you use regularly (Helium 10, Jungle Scout, etc.)

Links to live listings or storefronts you've worked on (if shareable)

Your hourly rate or monthly retainer expectation (in USD)

Your weekly availability (hours per week and your timezone)

Why Work With Us

We're not a churn-and-burn shop — we value long-term relationships and will invest in your growth

Clear SOPs and training will be provided for our specific workflows

You'll have room to grow as our Amazon presence expands

We pay on time, communicate clearly, and respect your time

title: YouTube Video Editor
description:
About the role:

---------------------

We run Voyager, a YouTube channel that investigates the great unsolved mysteries of math, science, and engineering. Our videos are rigorously researched and told as stories, so any curious person feels both the awe of the unknown and the satisfaction of finally understanding it. Our editing style prioritizes clarity, accuracy, and detail over flashy effects — every graphic earns its place by making an abstract idea easier to understand.



You'll work directly with our two founders/creative directors on a channel with 7k+ subscribers and 450k+ views.

See our style on our YouTube 



What you'll do:

---------------------

Edit 2–3 long-form videos per month (typically 20–25 min each), roughly one finished video per week. A full edit includes: assembly and pacing from provided A-roll and script, color grading, sound design (compression, EQ, music selection), B-roll sourcing, motion graphics/animations, and maintaining a cohesive brand look throughout.



You're a fit if you have:

---------------------

Proven experience editing long-form YouTube videos with a strong grasp of YouTube pacing and storytelling (think Johnny Harris, Vox, Cleo Abram, 3Blue1Brown)

Proficiency in DaVinci Resolve (Studio not required)

Ability to create motion graphics and simple animations

Comfort sourcing B-roll and doing sound design (compression, EQ, licensed music)

Fluent English and experience working async in a remote team

Bonus: a background or strong interest in math, engineering, or physics



Expectations:

---------------------

One finished 20–25 min video per week

Weekly 1-hour call with the creative directors

Consistent deadlines; up to 3 revision rounds per video included

Async communication over WhatsApp, replies within 24 hours on workdays



Rate:

---------------------

$10 per finished minute — most videos run 20–25 min, so roughly $200–$250 per video, paid per video on delivery. Included revision rounds are covered by the per-minute rate. Performance-based bonuses available.



How to apply:

---------------------

Step 1 — Reply by answering the following questions:

1. In two or three sentences, tell us one YouTube channel whose editing you admire and why.

2. Do you have a background or strong interest in math, science, or engineering? Tell us briefly.

3. Link to your portfolio/reel/channel/Resume

4. Link 1-2 long form YouTube Videos you have personally edited. (Send Youtube link ONLY) 



Step 2 — Paid trial edit. Selected candidates will be invited to a paid trial ($20) — a short intro video plus a 2-minute edited clip using our actual footage, which we'll send you directly. This is where we see how you work with our material.



Step 3 — Final interview. Candidates whose trial stands out meet with our creative directors, Madeline and Aditya, to talk through the edit, working style, and the role.

title: Video editor,. Time Stamp
description:
# Podcast & Short-Form Video Editor (Story-Driven)



## About the Role



We're looking for an editor with a storyteller's instinct — someone who can take hours of raw footage, transcripts, or a list of rough timestamps and *find the 
nts that matter*. This isn't about mechanically trimming silence and slapping on captions. We want someone who watches for the laugh, the tension, the turn of phrase that makes a clip worth sharing — and then edits with pacing, motion, and sound design to bring that 
nt to life.



You'll handle full-length podcast episodes end-to-end, then mine that same raw footage for short-form clips that actually stop the scroll. If you love finding the story hiding inside unedited footage as much as you love a clean audio mix, this is for you.



## Responsibilities



- **Find the story first**: review raw footage, transcripts, or timestamp notes to identify the strongest 
nts — compelling soundbites, emotional beats, funny exchanges, quotable lines — before cutting

- Edit full-length podcast episodes: cutting, pacing, noise reduction, and audio mixing

- Cut short-form content (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) from long-form episodes that feels alive, not just trimmed — with editing choices, sound, and motion that add energy

- Create motion graphics (lower thirds, titles, transitions, animated text, dynamic captions) that enhance the story rather than decorate it

title: Graphic Designer
description:
About the Role 



We are looking for a talented Graphic Designer to join our creative team and support the design needs of a growing digital marketing and web agency. This role is ideal for someone who understands the fundamentals of strong visual design, brand consistency, layout, typography, color theory, and digital-first creative production. 



The right candidate should be comfortable creating professional design assets for websites, social media, paid advertising, branding,
 campaigns, and occasional print materials. We value designers who can think creatively, follow brand guidelines, adapt to different client industries, and produce high-quality work without relying heavily on AI-generated design. 



AI tools may be used as part of a modern workflow, but this role requires a designer with real design judgment, strong fundamentals, and hands-on experience using professional creative software. 



Responsibilities 



Create high-quality visual assets for websites, landing pages, social media, paid ads,
 campaigns, presentations, and print materials. 



Design graphics for Meta ads, Google display ads, organic social media content, website banners, blog images, thumbnails, flyers, brochures, and brand collateral. 



Support brand identity development, including logos, color palettes, typography selections, brand guidelines, and visual systems. 



Edit, resize, and adapt creative assets for multiple platforms and formats. 



Work with marketing, web development, and content teams to create visuals that align with campaign goals and client brand standards. 



Prepare production-ready files for both digital and print use. 



Maintain organized design files and follow internal naming, storage, and version-control practices. 



Review creative briefs and translate business goals into visually effective design concepts. 



Ensure all creative work is consistent, polished, and aligned with each client’s brand voice and audience. 



Make revisions based on feedback while maintaining strong design quality and attention to detail. 



Stay current with design trends, digital advertising formats, social media creative standards, and modern design tools. 



Required Qualifications 



Proven experience as a Graphic Designer, Visual Designer, Brand Designer, or similar creative role. 



Strong portfolio showing professional design work across digital marketing, branding, websites, social media, and advertising. 



Strong understanding of design fundamentals, including layout, hierarchy, typography, color, composition, spacing, and brand consistency. 



Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, especially: 



Adobe Photoshop 



Adobe Illustrator 



Adobe InDesign 



Adobe XD or Adobe Express is a plus 



Ability to create and edit original design assets, not just modify templates. 



Experience designing for digital marketing campaigns, including Meta/Facebook ads, Instagram graphics, Google display ads, and website imagery. 



Ability to follow brand guidelines and adapt design style across multiple client brands. 



Strong attention to detail and ability to produce polished, client-ready work. 



Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced agency environment. 



Good communication skills and ability to accept feedback professionally. 



Preferred Qualifications 



Experience working in a digital marketing agency, web agency, or creative agency. 



Canva experience for creating editable client-facing templates. 



Experience with Figma, Sketch, or other modern UI/design collaboration tools. 



Basic understanding of website design principles, responsive layouts, and UX/UI best practices. 



Experience creating brand identity packages, social media ad campaigns, and landing page graphics. 



Experience preparing files for print production. 



Basic understanding of motion graphics, video editing, or animation is a plus. 



Familiarity with tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or similar platforms is a plus. 



Experience designing for different industries and client types. 



AI Tool Expectations 



We are open to the use of AI tools as part of a creative workflow, but this position is not for someone who depends on AI to do the core design work. The ideal candidate understands how to create strong designs from scratch, make thoughtful creative decisions, and use professional design tools with confidence. 



AI may be used for brainstorming, concept exploration, or workflow support, but final creative work must reflect strong human design judgment, originality, brand awareness, and professional execution. 



What We Are Looking For 



We are looking for someone who can: 



Think creatively while still designing with business goals in mind. 



Understand the difference between attractive design and effective design. 



Create work that looks professional, intentional, and brand-aligned. 



Balance creativity with speed and production needs. 



Take direction while also contributing ideas. 



Work across multiple brands without making every design look the same. 



Understand how design impacts marketing performance, user experience, and brand perception. 



Portfolio Requirement 



Applicants must submit a portfolio with examples of relevant design work. We are especially interested in seeing: 



Brand identity or logo work 



Social media graphics 



Paid ad creative 



Website imagery or landing page design 



Print collateral 



Before-and-after design improvements 



Any examples showing original layout, typography, and composition skills 



Job Type 



Full-time, part-time, or contract, depending on candidate fit and availability. 



Schedule 

Flexible, but availability during standard business hours for meetings, feedback, and collaboration is preferred. 



How to Apply 



Please submit your resume, portfolio, and a short note explaining your design experience, the tools you use most often, and the type of creative work you enjoy most.

We review credit card processing statements for small US businesses, identify hidden fees, and negotiate with processors to get those charges removed. Our clients pay nothing upfront, we only earn when they save.



The Role

Analyst and negotiator. You receive processing statements, identify every fee, calculate savings, call processors to negotiate corrections, and prepare the final savings report. No client contact, you work internally with the team. Part time to being with, increasing to full time.



What You'll Do

    • Analyze merchant processing statements to identify fees and overcharges

    • Calculate projected savings using provided worksheets

    • Contact processors to negotiate fee reductions or removals

    • Document outcomes and prepare client-ready savings reports



Requirements

    • Experience in financial analysis, bookkeeping, auditing, or a similar detail-oriented role

    • Comfortable making professional phone calls to US companies and negotiating calmly

    • Strong spreadsheet skills

    • Excellent written and spoken English

    • Reliable internet, quiet workspace, and own computer

    • Bookkeeping or accounting experience is a plus



Compensation

    • $6.00/hour

    • Part time initially, with opportunity to grow as client base expands

    • Paid monthly



What We Provide

    • Reliable, on-time monthly pay

    • Flexible schedule

    • Long-term opportunity as the business grows

    • Generous bonuses for exceeding KPIs



How to Apply

Send:

    1. Your resume or summary of relevant experience

    2. A brief note on any experience with financial analysis, bookkeeping, or phone based negotiation

    3. Your preferred working hours (in PHT)

title: Outbound Telemarketing / Live Transfer Specialist
description:
# Outbound Telemarketing / Live Transfer Specialist



**Company:** Quote Genie

**Work Arrangement:** Remote – Philippines

**Schedule:** Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Arizona Time

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Compensation:** $3 - $5 USD per hour (Depending on Experience) plus $1 USD per qualified transfer



## About Quote Genie



Quote Genie is a U.S.-based telemarketing company that connects interested consumers with licensed insurance professionals. Our team contacts leads provided by our clients, identifies prospects who are interested in receiving an insurance quote, and transfers qualified prospects directly to the client.



We are looking for a dependable, confident, and results-driven telemarketer who is comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls.



## Position Overview



As a Live Transfer Specialist, you will contact U.S.-based insurance prospects using our dialing system. Your responsibility is to follow the approved script, determine whether the prospect is interested in receiving an insurance quote, and successfully transfer qualified prospects to our clients.



This is a full-time overnight position for candidates located in the Philippines.



## Compensation



* $3 - $5 USD per hour (Depending on Experience)

* $1 USD for every accepted, qualified transfer

* Approximately 40 paid hours per week

* Performance-based earning potential

* Opportunity for future raises and advancement



A representative who consistently produces 10 qualified transfers per day can earn approximately $1,000 USD or more per month.



## Work Schedule



* Monday through Friday

* 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Arizona Time

* Overnight schedule in the Philippines

* 30-minute paid lunch

* Candidates must be able to work this schedule consistently



## Daily Responsibilities



* Make high-volume outbound calls using PhoneBurner

* Follow the approved calling script

* Speak professionally with U.S.-based consumers

* Identify prospects interested in receiving an insurance quote

* Transfer qualified prospects to our clients

* Accurately disposition every call

* Honor all do-not-call requests immediately

* Attend scheduled coaching and training sessions

* Communicate attendance, internet, or technical issues promptly

* Maintain a professional and positive attitude throughout the shift



## Performance Expectations



* Approximately 750 outbound dials per day

* Goal of 10–12 qualified transfers per day

* Strong attendance and punctuality

* Accurate call dispositions

* Consistent script and compliance adherence

* High-quality transfers with minimal client returns

* Ability to receive coaching and apply feedback quickly



## Qualified Transfer Requirements



A transfer must:



* Be successfully connected to the client

* Involve a prospect who is genuinely interested in an insurance quote

* Meet all client qualification requirements

* Follow the approved script and compliance process

* Not be a duplicate, fake, disconnected, or do-not-call lead

* Be accepted by the client and not returned or refunded



Transfer bonuses are paid only on accepted, non-refunded transfers.



## Required Qualifications



* Strong spoken English

* Clear and professional phone presence

* Previous outbound calling, appointment-setting, collections, sales, insurance, solar, real estate, or call-center experience

* Comfortable handling objections and rejection

* Ability to sound natural while following a script

* Strong listening and communication skills

* Reliable attendance

* Ability to work independently in a remote environment

* Willingness to receive coaching and meet performance expectations



## Technical Requirements



Applicants must have:



* Reliable computer or laptop

* High-quality wired USB headset

* Stable high-speed internet connection

* Backup internet option

* Quiet and professional workspace

* Reliable power and a backup plan for outages

* Ability to use PhoneBurner, Slack, Google Sheets, and web-based systems



## How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Your updated résumé.

2. A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and describing your outbound calling experience.

3. A screenshot of your current internet speed test.

4. Your computer specifications.

5. A description of your backup internet and power plan.

6. Confirmation that you can permanently work 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Arizona Time.

7. A short explanation of why you would be successful in a high-volume outbound calling position.



To confirm that you carefully read the entire posting, begin your application with the words:



**“Qualified Transfer”**



Applications without the required voice recording or opening phrase will not be considered.



## Hiring Process



Selected candidates will complete:



* Initial application review

* Voice and communication screening

* Video interview

* Live objection-handling role-play

* Paid dialing audition

* Background and reference verification



We are looking for someone who wants stable, long-term work and is motivated by performance-based earning opportunities.

title: Senior Commercial Real Estate Financial Analyst (U.S. CRE)
description:
Job Type: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Location: Remote (Philippines)

Schedule: Semi-flexible, typically 3:00 PM – 12:00 AM Manila Time





About Us



We are a well-funded and fast-growing FinTech company founded by industry leaders from Wall Street and Silicon Valley. Our mission is to transform how commercial real estate financial data is processed through advanced technology, automation, and artificial intelligence.



As part of our continued growth, we’re building a team of experienced Commercial Real Estate professionals who can accurately interpret complex U.S. CRE financial documents and transform them into high-quality structured datasets that power next-generation AI models.







About the Role



We are seeking a Senior Commercial Real Estate Financial Analyst with a strong background in U.S. Commercial Real Estate accounting, underwriting, and financial analysis.



This role goes beyond document review. You will analyze and validate financial information from commercial real estate documents, ensuring accuracy and consistency while applying your accounting and financial expertise to interpret complex transactions.



The ideal candidate has extensive experience working with T12 operating statements, rent rolls, loan agreements, property financial statements, and underwriting packages for U.S. commercial real estate assets.







Key Responsibilities



    * Review and analyze U.S. Commercial Real Estate financial documents, including:

    * Trailing Twelve Month (T12) Operating Statements

    * Property Profit & Loss Statements

    * Balance Sheets

    * Rent Rolls

    * Loan Agreements

    * Freddie Mac and Fannie Mae loan documents

    * Offering Memorandums (OMs)

    * Purchase & Sale Agreements

    * Appraisal Reports

    * Property Financial Statements

* Interpret financial data and ensure information is accurately extracted and validated.

* Analyze financial metrics including:

    * Net Operating Income (NOI)

    * Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR)

    * Capitalization Rate (Cap Rate)

    * Occupancy

    * Operating Expenses

    * Effective Gross Income (EGI)

    * Debt Service

    * Cash Flow

* Identify discrepancies, anomalies, and inconsistencies across multiple financial documents.

* Validate extracted financial data using accounting principles and CRE best practices.

* Organize and maintain structured datasets used for AI model training.

* Collaborate with internal teams to improve extraction accuracy and document review processes.

* Maintain the highest standards of quality, confidentiality, and data integrity.





Required Qualifications



Experience



* Minimum 5 years of professional experience in U.S. Commercial Real Estate.

* Background in Accounting, Finance, Commercial Real Estate, Asset Management, Underwriting, or Commercial Lending.

* Experience analyzing U.S. Commercial Real Estate financial statements.

* Hands-on experience reviewing T12 Operating Statements is required.

* Experience reviewing Rent Rolls is required.

* Experience reviewing Loan Agreements and financing documents.

* Experience supporting underwriting, acquisitions, asset management, lending, or due diligence.

* This role is not suitable for junior analysts.







Technical Skills



Must have strong understanding of:



* U.S. Commercial Real Estate

* Multifamily properties

* Property accounting

* Financial statement analysis

* Commercial lending

* Underwriting

* GAAP accounting fundamentals

* NOI

* DSCR

* Cap Rate

* Debt Service

* Cash Flow Analysis

* Rent Roll Analysis

* T12 Financial Analysis





Excel & Analytical Skills



Advanced Microsoft Excel skills are required, including:



* Pivot Tables

* XLOOKUP / INDEX-MATCH

* SUMIFS

* Logical formulas

* Financial calculations

* Data validation

* Large dataset analysis



You should be highly analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with complex financial datasets.





Preferred Qualifications



Experience with any of the following is highly desirable:



* Freddie Mac

* Fannie Mae

* CMBS loans

* Yardi

* RealPage

* MRI

* Argus Enterprise

* CoStar

* Commercial loan servicing

* CRE acquisitions

title: Architectural Designer, Draftsperson or Residential Planner
description:
The role will involve preparing and updating residential concept plans, floor plans, elevations, site layouts and supporting documentation for new homes, prefabricated buildings, relocatable homes, renovations, minor dwellings and property development projects.



This is an overflow role rather than a guaranteed full-time position. Work will be allocated as projects arise, with the potential for regular ongoing hours for the right person.



Key Responsibilities



* Prepare residential concept plans from written briefs, sketches and site information.

* Develop functional floor plans for new homes, minor dwellings and relocatable buildings.

* Prepare site plans showing building locations, access, parking, boundaries, outdoor areas and service locations.

* Produce architectural floor plans, elevations, sections and construction details.

* Modify existing plans to suit different sites, client requirements and building dimensions.

* Prepare plans for renovations, additions, internal alterations and changes of use.

* Assist with preliminary property development layouts and yield assessments.

* Review site dimensions, title plans, council GIS information and planning constraints.

* Prepare planning diagrams showing setbacks, site coverage, recession planes, outdoor living areas and parking.

* Assist with resource consent and building consent drawing packages.

* Coordinate architectural drawings with structural, civil, geotechnical and services information.

* Update drawings following engineer, council, client or construction-team feedback.

* Prepare schedules for doors, windows, finishes, rooms and building components.

* Produce clear presentation drawings for lenders, agents, clients and internal feasibility assessments.

* Maintain consistent drawing standards, file naming and document-control systems.

* Identify design conflicts, missing information and potential consent issues before drawings are issued.

* Provide accurate drawing revisions within agreed deadlines.



Typical Projects



Projects may include:



* One- to four-bedroom residential homes.

* Prefabricated and transportable homes.

* Minor dwellings and secondary residential units.

* Residential subdivisions and multi-dwelling developments.

* Existing-home renovations and extensions.

* Garage conversions and residential accommodation above garages.

* Relocation and installation of existing buildings.

* Site feasibility and preliminary development planning.

* Standard-plan modifications for different sections and client requirements.



Required Experience and Skills



* Previous experience as an Architectural Designer, Architectural Draftsperson, Building Designer or Residential Planner.

* Strong experience preparing residential floor plans, elevations, sections and site plans.

* Ability to interpret surveys, title plans, engineering drawings and architectural briefs.

* Strong understanding of residential space planning and building functionality.

* Experience producing accurate CAD or BIM drawings.

* Proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit, ArchiCAD, SketchUp or similar architectural software.

* Strong attention to dimensions, levels, drawing coordination and document accuracy.

* Clear written and spoken English.

* Ability to work independently and manage multiple small projects.

* Ability to work from incomplete information and clearly identify questions or assumptions.

* Reliable internet connection and suitable computer equipment for architectural drafting.



Preferred Experience



Experience in any of the following would be advantageous:



* New Zealand or Australian residential construction.

* New Zealand Building Code and residential consent documentation.

* New Zealand district plan rules and planning terminology.

* Timber-framed residential buildings.

* Prefabricated, modular or transportable construction.

* Residential property development and subdivision planning.

* Resource consent or building consent drawing packages.

* Producing plans for engineering, council or construction review.

* Small-home and space-efficient residential design.

* 3D modelling and realistic exterior presentations.

* Preparing quantity schedules or material take-off information.

* Construction detailing for foundations, wall framing, roofing, cladding and wet areas.



We are looking for someone who:



* Produces practical and buildable residential designs.

* Understands the difference between an attractive concept and a design that can be efficiently constructed.

* Checks dimensions, room sizes, circulation and furniture layouts carefully.

* Follows instructions while also identifying better design solutions.

* Clearly records assumptions and raises issues before completing detailed work.

* Can turn rough sketches and verbal instructions into professional drawings.

* Responds well to design feedback and revision requests.

* Can complete urgent overflow work without sacrificing accuracy.

* Is interested in developing a long-term working relationship.



This is an overflow position, with hours varying depending on our project workload.



Some weeks may involve only minor plan changes, while other periods may involve several active residential projects. Applicants must be comfortable with variable hours and project-based deadlines.



The successful applicant should be available for occasional online meetings during New Zealand working hours. Most drafting work can be completed flexibly.



Please include the following with your application:



1. A brief introduction outlining your architectural drafting and residential design experience.

2. Details of your experience with New Zealand or Australian construction, if applicable.

3. The architectural software you use and your level of proficiency.

4. Examples of residential floor plans, elevations, sections and site plans you have prepared.

5. Examples of consent or construction drawing packages, with confidential details removed.

6. Your normal turnaround time for concept plans and drawing revisions.

7. Your availability and preferred working hours.





Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a small paid design or drafting exercise before ongoing work is allocated.

title: Creator Operations Manager
description:
We are a fast-growing creator management agency scaling rapidly in both revenue and roster size. The single biggest lever on our revenue is operational consistency — making sure every creator on our platform is supported by systems, standards, and workflows that convert and monetise their audience reliably and at scale. This role owns that engine.



WHAT WE OFFER

— Competitive compensation based on experience

 — Fully remote, full-time (9am-6pm PHT, Mon-Fri)

 — Reports directly to the Chief Revenue Officer

 — A systems-ownership role with real impact on revenue at scale

 — A fast-moving, operationally serious team that builds to last

 — Clear path to grow as the roster and operations function scale



THE ROLE

This role does not sell. It makes selling repeatable.

As Creator Operations Manager you will own the operational engine behind our creator portfolio. You will build, document, and continuously improve the workflows, quality standards, and content systems that allow the Chat team to convert and monetise every audience — consistently and at scale. You will manage the Content VA and Audience Engagement VA, with scope to grow the team as the operation scales.

Success here is defined by how reliably the system performs — not by how much work you personally do.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- The operations system end to end — maintain core workflows covering content planning, PPV and customs preparation, welcome bundles, profile optimisation, audience engagement, and cross-team issue resolution, fully documented so execution never depends on any single person

- The weekly operating cadence — lead a data-driven weekly review of every creator's core quality metrics, translate gaps into specific production actions, and hold the team accountable against a visible scorecard

- Quality and content standards — QA every workflow output against a defined quality standard before it reaches the Chat team, with a strong audience-experience lens so content is packaged to convert

- Documentation and systemisation with AI leverage — convert tacit know-how into clear, adopted SOPs, using AI tooling to build and maintain workflows quickly and keep them current

- Team leadership and cross-functional collaboration — coach and develop the operations team, partner with Chat and Client Success to resolve creator concerns within SLA, protecting retention and reducing churn

- Portfolio prioritisation — review account performance weekly, identify lagging accounts, prioritise operational resources based on revenue opportunity and risk, and track improvement plans through completion



NON-NEGOTIABLES

— Documentation discipline: if it isn't in the system, it doesn't exist

 — Data over opinion: every decision on content, profiles, and priorities is anchored to performance data, reviewed weekly

 — Standards leadership: holds the line on quality and process even under pressure to cut corners for short-term output



WHAT YOU WILL BE MEASURED ON

— Weekly deliverables consistently shipped on time and meeting defined QA standards

 — Operational issues resolved within agreed SLAs, each with a durable fix logged

 — Quality trends improving consistently across the portfolio, with lagging accounts closed rather than ignored

 — Chat team consistently receiving complete, production-ready content and assets

 — Documentation enabling rapid onboarding and reducing dependence on any single individual Targets and weightings set quarterly with the Chief Revenue Officer.



WHAT YOU BRING

Experience (non-negotiable)

 — 3+ years in operations or operations leadership within a remote, fast-paced business — agency, SaaS, startup, eCommerce, BPO, customer operations, or creator business

 — Demonstrated ownership of documented workflows and SOPs with measurable process improvement

 — Experience managing a remote team or direct reports

 — Creator economy or subscription platform experience preferred but not required



Skills (must-have)

 — Workflow platforms — Process Street, ClickUp, Asana, or similar

 — AI tools — Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent — used to build and maintain processes

 — Strong spreadsheet and data literacy, comfortable turning numbers into action

 — Comfortable analysing operational dashboards, identifying bottlenecks, and translating data into clear operational actions

 — SOP writing, documentation, and project management

 — Clear written and verbal English

 — Sound visual and creative judgment — able to raise the quality of profiles, welcome bundles, and content with a strong audience-experience lens, while keeping execution consistent and on-standard



Who you are (non-negotiable)

 — Highly accountable, structured, and detail-oriented

 — Calm under pressure, coachable, and curious

 — A natural systems-improver who leads through influence and accountability

 — Comfortable with change and building in a fast-moving environment



LOGISTICS

Location: Remote. Philippines preferred, South Africa considered.

Hours: Full-time, 8 hours per day, 5 days per week. Overlap window with Revenue team hours to be confirmed.

Language: Clear written and verbal English required

Reports to: Chief Revenue Officer



ASSESSMENT

You'll be the right hand keeping tasks on track, communications flowing, marketing moving, and leads followed up — someone who can take initiative rather than waiting to be told what to do next.



What You'll Be Doing



• Daily task organisation — managing to-do lists, priorities, and deadlines across the team

•
 drafting & inbox management — writing clear, professional
s and helping manage correspondence

• Accounting Data Entry — Input data into Xero from existing Bills & submit for approval, follow up overdue invoices, identify due dates for bills



What We're Looking For



• 2+ years of experience as a Virtual Assistant or in a similar admin/marketing support role

• Strong written and spoken English

• Experience with (or fast ability to learn) project management tools — Wunderbuild experience is a strong plus

• Comfortable with social media platforms and basic content creation

• Reliable internet connection and own equipment

• Available to overlap with Australian business hours (AEST)



How to Apply — Please Read Carefully



Applications that don't follow these instructions exactly will not be shortlisted. This is intentional — it's the fastest way for both of us to know you're a good fit.



1. Subject line requirement

Use this exact subject line when applying: VA Application – Strawberry Fields

(If your subject line doesn't match, your application won't be opened — this is the first filter.)



2. Resume/CV

Submit your current resume outlining relevant experience.



3. Introduction video (2–3 minutes)

Record a short video covering:

• Who you are and your VA/admin/marketing background

• An example of a time you managed competing priorities or a difficult task

• Why you'd be a good fit for this role



Somewhere in the video, naturally say the word "strawberry." This confirms you've read the full posting and can follow instructions precisely — a core skill for this role.

In your application message, answer this: "What's one tool or system you've used to keep yourself organised, and why does it work for you?"

Generic or copy-pasted cover letters that don't answer this will be skipped.



5. Work sample (optional but strongly recommended)

Attach 1–2 examples of your past work — e.g. a social media post you created, an
 you drafted, or a screenshot of a project board you managed. Real samples move you to the top of the pile.



Additional Screening We'll Use (for shortlisted applicants)



• Short paid test task — a small, real (paid) task such as drafting a sample
 reply or organising a mock task list, to see how you work in practice

• Timezone/availability confirmation — a quick async check to confirm real overlap with AEST hours

• Reference check — one prior client or employer reference

• Live video call — a short conversation to confirm communication skills and verify the intro video was genuinely you

title: Customer Support Phone Agent, US Brand (Remote, Part-Time)
description:
Schedule: Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday, Sunday, 8-hour shifts, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM US Eastern Time



Start date: As soon as possible



About the Role:



We run live phone support for our US webshop. Right now we receive around 20 calls a day (roughly 2–3 per hour), and we expect this volume to grow significantly over the coming weeks, so comfort with a fast-growing call queue is essential.



Every call is a chance to help a customer and a chance to close a sale. You'll answer inbound calls covering both existing-order questions (status, returns, exchanges, shipping) and new sales enquiries, and you'll be expected to actively guide callers toward completing their purchase, not just answer questions. Our goal is to answer 98%+ of all incoming calls.



Between calls, there will be downtime that can be used for related tasks such as
 support and call logging.



Responsibilities:

- Answer inbound customer calls on our phone line during your assigned shifts

- Advise customers on products, sizing, and fit, and actively close sales by creating a Shopify draft order for every closed sale

- Return missed calls and voi
s within 12 hours

- Handle customer
s during phone downtime, using our macro library for consistent responses

- Log every call accurately and same-day (call type, outcome, sale amount)

- Issue store credit or discount codes when resolving customer issues

- Escalate complex cases (disputes, shipment problems, VIP customers) following our escalation process

- Stay current on products, promotions, and policies, including during weeks you're not on shift



Requirements:

- Sales experience – for us, support is sales. You must be comfortable advising a customer and then actively asking for and closing the sale, not just answering the question

- US e-commerce experience, ideally hands-on creating draft orders in Shopify

- Neutral, US-friendly accent – our customers should feel they're speaking with someone based in the US

- Clear, friendly spoken and written English

- Genuine long-term availability during US Eastern business hours (9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST). For Philippines-based applicants, this is a permanent night shift (approximately 9:00 PM–5:00 AM or 10:00 PM–6:00 AM PHT, depending on US daylight saving time). Please only apply if you're comfortable with this long-term

- Experience with a helpdesk platform (Zendesk preferred) and confidence picking up new tools quickly (Quo, Rise AI, Shopify admin, Google Sheets)

- Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet work environment, and a quality headset

- Strong attention to detail for call logging and reporting



Nice to Have:

- Familiarity with footwear or apparel e-commerce (sizing, returns, exchanges)

- Prior on-call, relief, or reliever scheduling experience



Compensation:

- $5/hour base rate

- 7% commission on every phone sale you close (a sale counts once a draft order is created under your name and the customer completes payment)

- Commission is calculated from the call tracking sheet and paid with your regular monthly pay cycle

description:
# Real Estate Virtual Assistant | Lead Follow-Up & Appointment Setter

**GoHighLevel (GHL) | Remote | Toronto (EST) Hours, Weekends Can Be Included**



---



## About Us



I'm a real estate sales agent working on a pre-construction in the GTA Toronto , Canada. My focus is giving buyers clear, honest guidance from their first inquiry through to closing.



I'm looking for a reliable, personable Virtual Assistant to follow up with leads within 5 minutes of signing up through my ads and get them booked in for appointments. This is not a cold-calling or expired-listing role. Our leads have already shown interest; they just need to be booked in to my calendar.



You do not need to be a real estate expert. You'll only need to know a handful of our products well enough to answer basic questions. Anything more detailed gets passed straight to me.



---



## Your Responsibilities



- Follow up with leads by phone, text, and
 using GoHighLevel (GHL)

- Tagging Leads & Keep accurate, up-to-date notes on every lead in GHL

- Set appointments 

- Answer basic questions on a small number of products (we'll train you on these)

- Leave professional voi
s when calls go unanswered



All the other automations will take care of lead nurture. **Once a lead is hot, or an appointment is booked, the lead is passed to me completely and out of your hands.



---



## Daily Goals



This is not a high-pressure cold-calling role. The main goal is consistent, timely follow-up on every lead assigned to you, working toward a steady number of qualified appointments booked each day. We'll set specific weekly targets together once we see how lead volume flows. Typically we are booking 1 out of 10 leads in , average of 20-30 leads per day coming in.



---



## Required Experience



You must have experience with:

- GoHighLevel (GHL)

- Real estate, even if only a little

- Appointment setting & lead follow-up

- Objection handling

- Fluent spoken English



Bonus experience:

- Familiarity with the Canadian real estate market, especially the GTA

- Pre-construction or new home sales

- Working remotely across time zones



---



## Work Schedule



- 10:00/11:00 AM to 7:00 PM Toronto time (EST), every day can also work weekends

- You will be asigned a list of calls as they come in or need to be followed up with

- Your shift may include breaks between calls depending on lead flow, so it is not always one continuous block



---



## Compensation



- Starting base: $800 CAD per month

- Bonus: $250 CAD or more per closed deal

- With bonuses, most people in this role can expect to reach $2,000+ CAD per month

- Base pay can grow from here based on performance



---



## What Success Looks Like



You're doing well if you:

- Build trust quickly with leads

- Keep conversations warm and professional

- Handle basic questions confidently and know when to hand off to me

- Consistently book qualified appointments

- Keep GHL clean and up to date



---



## To Apply



Please include the following:

1. Your resume

2. A short voice recording (2-3 minutes) introducing yourself in English

3. Your experience with GoHighLevel (GHL)

4. A brief note on what you know about the Canadian real estate market

5. A recording of a past sales or appointment-setting call, if you have one



**Important:** To show us you read the full posting, start your application with the words "Toronto Ready."

Please include the word Purple in the first sentence of your application so I know you read the entire posting.

title: Client Success Manager
description:
Get to know who we serve before you apply:


 




 

WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT



Most "support" roles are a ticket queue. A client complains, you copy-paste a reply, you close the ticket, you forget the human.



Market Leaders doesn't work that way.



Our clients are high-performing operators — property agents, financial advisors, business owners — who pay us to help them grow. They don't need a help desk. They need someone in their corner who keeps them on track, removes the friction, and finds the thing they couldn't find themselves.



That's you.



You're the person who notices a client has gone quiet and reaches out before they fall behind. You're the one who walks them through the tool they're stuck on. You're the one who, when a client says "I can't figure out how to do X," just... handles it.



If you're genuinely tech-savvy, genuinely organised, and you actually like helping people win — read on.



This is a fully remote role for someone who takes ownership, not someone who waits for tickets.



ABOUT MARKET LEADERS

Market Leaders is a Singapore-based social media consulting company. We help high-performing operators turn their expertise into content and systems that compound.



We work with:

- **Property agents** doing $500M+ in transactions, leading 30+ agent teams

- **Financial advisors** running established lead and ad systems

- **Business owners + coaches** building personal brands that drive real revenue



We teach the 5 C's — Character, Content, Community, Convert, Client — and we believe in systems, not willpower. Peaceful and profitable.



Here's the truth about coaching: the clients who get results are the ones who keep showing up and doing the work. Your job is to make that easy — to keep them accountable, unblock them on the tech, and be the reliable hand they can reach for. You protect the client relationship so our coaches and founders can focus on the coaching.





TOTAL COMPENSATION PACKAGE



**Base Salary:** SGD $800-1,000/month (paid via Wise or PayPal in SGD)

Range depends on experience and how much you can own from day one.



**What's Included**

- Fully remote — work from anywhere, as long as you overlap Singapore working hours (SGT)

- Direct training on our tools, our AI bots, our client systems, and how we work

- Exposure to how a real coaching business runs — the systems behind the scenes

- The tools you need to do the job well



**Work Benefits**

- Results-focused — we judge whether clients stay on track and feel supported, not your hours online

- Clear playbooks so you're never guessing how to handle something

- A role where being proactive and resourceful is the whole point, not a bonus



**Path Forward**

- Prove you can own the client relationship, and the scope grows — more clients, more responsibility, a senior customer-success track

- This is a long-term seat for the right person, not a gig





THE 4Rs — YOUR ROLE BREAKDOWN



### 1. ROLE — The Mission



Be the accountability and support layer for Market Leaders' clients.



You keep clients on track with what they committed to, you help them with the tech and tools they get stuck on, and you find the things they can't find for themselves. You're the reliable, proactive hand that makes the client experience feel handled.



Every interaction serves one objective: the client keeps moving forward, feels supported, and stays with us because the experience is excellent.



You'll use our AI tools and systems to help clients faster — but the care, the follow-through, and the judgment are yours.



### 2. RESPONSIBILITIES — The Day-to-Day Work



**Accountability & Check-ins — 35%**

- Track what each client committed to (from their coaching calls, client chart, and ongoing chats)

- Work inside client chats — reach out proactively, nudge, follow up, and check in before things slip

- Run a consistent weekly check-in rhythm with clients

- Log progress so the coaches and founders always know where each client stands



**Tech Support & Enablement — 30%**

- Help clients set up and use our tools, AI bots, portal, and the software they need

- Troubleshoot when something isn't working, calmly and clearly

- Run short screen-share walkthroughs when a client is stuck

- Write simple how-to guides so the same question doesn't come up twice



**Concierge & Research — 20%**

- Find the things clients can't find — resources, templates, vendors, answers, examples

- Do light research on the client's behalf so they don't lose time hunting

- Be the "let me sort that out for you" person clients come to rely on



**CRM Hygiene & Escalation — 15%**

- Keep the client chart, records, notes, and statuses clean and up to date

- Flag at-risk or quiet clients early

- Escalate the right things to coaches or founders — with context, not just "client's upset"



### 3. RESULTS — What Success Looks Like



**Foundation Phase — Month 1**

- Know the client roster, their commitments, and the tools they use

- Hit a consistent response time on every client message

- Learn our systems, AI bots, and playbooks well enough to handle common questions solo

- Run your first round of weekly check-ins



*This phase is about learning the clients, the tools, and the rhythm.*



**Growth Phase — Month 3**

- Own the weekly accountability loop — clients are being followed up with, on time, every week

- Resolve most tech questions yourself without escalating

- Build a small library of how-to guides for the questions that repeat

- Spot at-risk clients early and flag them with useful context



*This phase is where you stop reacting and start running the support engine.*



**Long-Term Impact — Month 6**

- Measurably lift client follow-through — clients are doing what they committed to

- Noticeably cut the number of routine questions reaching the founders and coaches

- Be the trusted point of contact clients reach for first

- Own the client-experience playbook and keep improving it



*This phase is where the client experience runs as a system you own.*



### 4. REQUIREMENTS — The Must-Haves



**Experience**

- Prior customer-facing experience — customer success, account management, support, or client coordination

- A track record of being the reliable, proactive one — examples welcome

- Comfortable working directly with clients who are busy, successful, and expect competence



**Skills**

- Excellent written and spoken English — most of this job is clear communication

- Genuinely tech-savvy — you learn new software and AI tools fast and can troubleshoot calmly

- Strongly organised — you don't drop follow-ups, and nothing falls through the cracks

- Resourceful — when you don't know something, you find out, you don't just give up



**Work Arrangement**

- Fully remote, but you must overlap core Singapore working hours (SGT) for client responsiveness

- Reliable laptop and internet — clients are counting on you to be reachable

- Able to commit long-term, not a short gig



**Work Style**

- Ownership mentality — a client's progress is your responsibility, not just your task list

- Proactive — you reach out before you're asked, you don't wait for problems to escalate

- Calm and warm under pressure — clients should feel handled, not managed

- Open to feedback and fast iteration — you'd rather hear "do this better" than "this is fine"





WHAT MAKES YOU THE PERFECT FIT

**You Take Ownership**

You don't ask "did I reply?" You ask "is this client actually moving forward?" Their progress is your scoreboard.



**You're Genuinely Good with Tech**

New tool, new AI bot, unfamiliar software — you figure it out fast, and you can explain it to someone who can't. You're the person friends call when something won't work.



**You're Proactive, Not Reactive**

You notice the quiet client. You follow up before the deadline. You flag the problem while it's still small. Clients never have to chase you.



**You're Resourceful**

"I couldn't find it" isn't in your vocabulary. When a client needs something, you go find it, figure it out, or get the answer.



**You're Organised to a Fault**

You track every commitment and every follow-up. Nothing slips. Your notes are clean enough that anyone could pick them up.



**You're Warm Without Being a Pushover**

You can hold a client accountable and keep them feeling supported at the same time. You're a direct, caring mentor, not a doormat and not a drill sergeant.



**You Communicate Clearly**

Whether it's a check-in, a how-to, or an escalation, your message is clear, kind, and gets to the point.





HOW TO APPLY

**1.
**

Send your application to: 

Subject line: **Client Support / Account Manager — [Your Name]**



AND 



Fill out this form: 



?? Please complete both steps. Applicants who complete only one step will not be considered.



**2. Include These 3 Things in the
**



**Relevant Experience**

- A short note on a client or customer relationship you owned, and what you did to keep them on track or solve a problem for them

- Any tools, software, or AI you're comfortable with (and how you've used them)



**Brief Response — 4 to 6 Sentences**



> *"A client tells you: 'I'm stuck — I can't get this tool to work and I'm falling behind on what I said I'd do this week.' Walk us through exactly how you'd handle it, start to finish. Be specific about what you'd say and what you'd do."*



This is the most important part of your application. We're hiring for ownership and judgment, not scripts. Generic answers = skipped application.



**Resume/CV**

PDF format only.



**3. Paid Trial — If Shortlisted**

We'll give you 3 sample client situations:

- An accountability nudge (a client who's gone quiet and is behind on a commitment)

- A tech question (a client stuck on one of our tools)

- A "can you find X for me" request



You'll write how you'd respond to each, and propose a simple weekly check-in cadence you'd run across a small client book.



- Turnaround: 48 hours from receipt of the brief

- Payment: **USD equivalent of SGD $40 via Wise or PayPal on submission**

- Paid regardless of outcome



The trial isn't testing whether you can write a polite reply. It's testing whether you can take ownership, communicate clearly, and actually solve the problem — including the tech.



**4. Interview**

- 30-minute video call with the Market Leaders team

- A short live scenario — we describe a client situation, you talk us through how you'd handle it

- Decision before offer





WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

- Application review: within 3-5 business days

- Top candidates contacted: within 48 hours of decision

- Full process: application ? paid trial ? interview ? offer, within 2 weeks max



We do not drag this out. If you are a fit, you will know. If not, you'll get a respectful "not this cycle" reply within a week.





NOT A FIT IF

This role is not for you if:

- You want a passive ticket-queue job where you wait for problems to come to you

- You need someone watching over you to stay on task — remote means self-managed

- You're not actually comfortable with software and troubleshooting

- You drop follow-ups or let things fall through the cracks

- You can't overlap Singapore working hours for client responsiveness

- You'd rather avoid hard conversations than hold a client accountable

- You want a short gig, not a long-term seat



If any of those describe you, that's fine. We'd rather know upfront.

title: Senior AI Video Editor - Direct Response · DTC Supplements
description:
Senior AI Video Editor

Direct Response · DTC Supplements · Women's Health



Remote · Full-time · US market

$2,000/mo base + performance bonuses · $3,500–$4,000+/mo realistic for top performers



We're not looking for someone who makes beautiful videos.

We're looking for someone who makes videos that make money.



If that distinction means something to you, keep reading. APPLY WITH THE WORD 'coffee' at the beginning, with this we prevent spam, we dont check application without.



About Us

We're building one of the fastest-growing direct response supplement brands in women's health.



Everything we do runs on one engine: creative. Not influencer deals, not retail placement, not a slow brand-awareness burn. We win by making advertising that outperforms everyone else in the category — then making more of it, faster than anyone else can react.



That means we're obsessed with the things most brands treat as an afterthought. Hooks. Retention curves. Angles. Awareness stages. The three seconds that decide whether a woman keeps scrolling or finally feels understood. We test relentlessly, we kill our darlings without sentiment, and we let the numbers settle every argument.



Our goal isn't to be a nice little brand. It's to be one of the largest in the category. Creative is how we get there — which makes this role one of the most important seats in the company.



The Role

You will own creative production across Meta, TikTok, YouTube and every other paid channel we run.

This is not "editing videos." Editing is a skill you already have — it's the price of admission, not the job.



The job is turning a raw idea, a script, a scroll of customer language and a pile of AI-generated footage into an ad that converts cold traffic into paying customers. You'll be handed angles, hooks and avatars, and you'll be expected to bring them to life at a volume and quality level most editors can't touch — because half of what you produce won't be filmed at all. It'll be built, frame by frame, inside AI tools that didn't exist eighteen months ago.



Every creative you ship has exactly one purpose:



Generate profitable revenue.



Not impress a director. Not win a Vimeo staff pick. Not look good in your reel. Make money — measurably, repeatedly, at scale.



If that sounds reductive to you, this is the wrong role. If it sounds like the most interesting creative constraint in the world, we should talk.



Responsibilities

Direct response editing

Edit high-converting UGC ads that feel native, urgent and real

Cut testimonial content that builds belief instead of just showing a talking customer

Build VSL-style long-form content that holds attention for minutes, not seconds

Produce product demonstrations that make the mechanism obvious and undeniable

Engineer the first three seconds of every ad as a standalone scroll-stopper

Build performance-first creatives — never aesthetic edits dressed up as ads



AI video production

Create fully AI-generated video ads from scratch — script to final export

Work with AI talking heads and build realistic AI avatars

Produce AI voiceovers and clean, believable lip sync

Run image-to-video workflows and build scenes inside AI video tools

Operate fluently across Veo, Runway, Kling, Hailuo, Higgsfield, Pika, Midjourney, Flux, ChatGPT, Claude — and whatever ships next month

Stay ahead of the tooling. The stack changes fast; we expect you to change with it



Craft

Motion graphics that support the message instead of decorating it

Sound design that carries pacing and emotion

Caption animation built for silent, thumb-driven viewing



Volume and velocity

Build dozens of creative angles every week

Produce multiple variations per concept for structured creative testing

Iterate winners fast — new hooks, new intros, new proof, new CTAs

Organize creative assets so nothing gets lost and everything gets reused

Build reusable editing systems, templates and workflows that compound your output over time



Collaboration

Work directly with the marketing team to read results and rapidly iterate on what's winning

Bring your own creative angles to the table — you're a strategist with an editing timeline, not a pair of hands



Requirements

Read this section carefully. If you don't meet these, please don't apply — we'd rather leave the seat open than fill it with someone who needs to be taught the fundamentals.



Non-negotiable:

Proven direct response experience — ads that ran, spent real budget, and produced results you can point to

Hands-on experience editing Meta ads

Experience working with DTC brands

Working understanding of US consumer psychology and how Americans actually buy

Strong grasp of hooks, retention, pacing and conversion psychology — you know why an ad drops off at second seven

Real experience with AI creative tools, and the ability to build a finished video from scratch using AI

Strong storytelling instincts

Excellent English

High attention to detail

Ability to work independently, without hand-holding or daily check-ins

Ability to take blunt feedback and turn it around fast





Highly preferred:

Experience in the supplement space



Portfolio requirement:

A portfolio showing high-performing ads is required. Not a showreel. Not a mood piece. Actual ads that ran on paid traffic, ideally with context on how they performed. If you can't show us work that sold something, we can't move forward.



Bonus Skills

Not required — but they'll move you up the list:



Motion design

3D

VFX

After Effects

Cinema 4D

Creative strategy

Copywriting

Thumbnail design

Understanding of landing pages and post-click experience

Ability to read Meta metrics and interpret them correctly

The ability to look at an ad and articulate why it won or lost



That last one is rarer than every other skill on this list. If you have it, say so.



Compensation

This is one of the biggest opportunities available to elite creative talent right now — and the structure reflects it.

Base: up to $2,000/month, depending on experience.



Performance bonuses: tied directly to winning creatives. When your ads hit agreed performance metrics — ROAS, CPA, spend thresholds or other KPIs — substantial monthly bonuses are paid on top of base.



Realistic top-performer range: $3,500–$4,000+/month.



We reward performance aggressively, and we're not shy about it. If you produce the creative that scales this company, your compensation scales with it. There is no ceiling written in stone here — there's only what you're worth to the business, and we intend to pay it.



The flip side: this structure is designed to be great for the best editors in the world, and unremarkable for everyone else. That's on purpose.



Culture

We move extremely fast. Speed is a real competitive advantage in this business and we treat it that way.

We test constantly. Most of what we make will lose, and that's fine — the losers pay for the winners.

There is no ego. Nobody defends a creative because they made it. The data decides, and we all move on within the hour.

Ideas win. Execution wins. Speed wins.

We care about outcomes, not hours logged. Nobody is counting your time. We're counting your winners.





Who Should NOT Apply

We're being specific here so we don't waste your time or ours.

Don't apply if you are:



A beginner editor

A wedding editor

A corporate video editor

A music video editor

An editor without direct response experience

An editor without AI workflow experience

An editor whose skill ceiling is basic CapCut

Someone who doesn't understand how paid advertising actually works



None of these are insults — they're different crafts, and some of them are harder than what we do. They're just not this job. Applying anyway will only get you a fast rejection.



Hiring Process



Portfolio review — we look at your ads, not your reel.

Practical editing assignment — a real brief, judged on DR instincts as much as execution.

Interview — creative thinking, tooling, how you diagnose a losing ad.

Paid trial — real work, real feedback loop, paid properly.

Offer.



We move quickly at every stage. We expect the same from you.



Apply

Send us:



Your portfolio — with the ads that performed, and the context on how they performed

One paragraph on the best-performing ad you've ever made, and why you think it won

A short note on which AI video tools you use and what you've built with them





If you're the editor we're describing, you already know it. Show us.

# Social Media Video Editor — Reels & Short-Form Content



**Company:** Investor Property Loan

**Position Type:** Freelance, Contract, or Part-Time



## About the Role

Investor Property Loan is looking for a creative and reliable **Social Media Video Editor** who can turn raw footage and long-form content into engaging, high-retention short-form videos.



You will edit Instagram Reels, TikTok videos, YouTube Shorts, and other vertical social media content focused on real estate investing, mortgage financing, DSCR loans, fix-and-flip loans, and related educational topics.



The ideal candidate understands how to capture attention within the first few seconds, identify the strongest moments from long-form content, and create videos that feel modern, professional, and native to social media.



## Responsibilities



* Edit engaging Instagram Reels, TikTok videos, and YouTube Shorts.

* Turn podcasts, interviews, webinars, and other long-form videos into short-form clips.

* Identify strong hooks, educational moments, and attention-grabbing sound bites.

* Add captions, headlines, transitions, graphics, sound effects, music, and supporting footage.

* Use AI-powered clipping and editing tools such as **OpusClip**, Descript, Captions, or similar platforms.

* Make reasonable revisions based on feedback.



## Qualifications



* Experience editing short-form social media videos.

* A portfolio of Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, or similar content.

* Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, and storytelling.

* Ability to identify the most valuable moments from long-form content.

* Proficiency with CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar editing software.

* Strong attention to detail, especially with captions, spelling, audio, and visual formatting.

* Ability to work independently and communicate clearly.

## Preferred Experience



* Experience editing content for real estate, mortgage, finance, business, or educational brands.

* Experience sourcing relevant B-roll and supporting visuals.

* Familiarity with content repurposing strategies.

* Ability to suggest hooks, titles, and on-screen text.

## What We’re Looking For



We are looking for someone who does more than simply cut footage. You should understand what makes people stop scrolling, continue watching, and take action.



You should also be comfortable using AI to speed up the editing process while still applying human judgment and creativity to produce polished, engaging content.



## How to Apply



Please submit:



* A brief introduction.
