Applicants may be asked to complete a short paid editing test.

title: Appointment Setter for US Insurance Agency — Objection Handling Required
description:
**Sales-Oriented Appointment Setter — US Insurance (Aged Leads, Phone) — Long-Term**



## Job Type / Terms



- **Type:** Full-time or part-time to start (open to the right person)

- **Schedule:** US business hours — **evening/night shift Philippine time** (you'll be dialing US Central Time windows, roughly 8:00 AM–8:00 PM CT). Must be reliably available in these hours.

- **Pay:** $[6–8]/hour to start + **per-appointment-showed bonus** once ramped (details in interview)

- **Start:** Paid test day first, then ongoing for the right fit



---



## About the Role



I run a US life-insurance agency. I need an experienced, **sales-oriented** appointment setter to call a list of aged mortgage-protection leads (people who previously mailed in a card requesting info) and **book them onto my calendar** for a quick phone appointment.



You are **not** selling and **not** quoting — I handle every insurance conversation myself. Your one job is to reactivate the lead, handle their objections, and lock in a firm same-day phone appointment. You'll dial on a multi-line dialer, follow a proven script, and book straight into my calendar.



This is a **long-term seat** for someone who's genuinely good on the phone. I'll give you the script, the system, and the leads. I need you to bring the phone skill.



---



## What You'll Do



- Make outbound calls to aged mortgage-protection leads on a multi-line dialer (expect 500–800 dials/day)

- Follow my reactivation script to warm the lead back up

- **Handle objections** — "I don't remember filling that out," "I already have insurance," "I'm not interested," "I'm busy" — and steer back to booking

- Book firm **same-day** phone appointments onto my calendar

- Confirm the callback number and pre-frame the appointment so the lead shows up

- Log dispositions cleanly after each call



---



## Who I'm Looking For (please read before applying)



**Required:**

- **Prior phone appointment-setting or telesales experience** — ideally US insurance, but strong US B2C phone experience counts

- **Excellent spoken English** — clear, warm, confident, easy for an older US homeowner to understand

- **Real objection-handling ability** — you can take a "no" or a "maybe" and turn it into a booked appointment without being pushy or robotic

- Comfortable on a dialer and hitting daily call volume

- Reliable internet, a quiet space, a good headset, and availability during US calling hours (your evening/night)

- Coachable — you'll follow my script and take feedback



**Not a fit if:**

- You've only done data entry, general VA work, or chat/email support (this is phone sales)

- You read scripts word-for-word and freeze when someone objects

- You're uncomfortable being on the phone all day

- You need daytime-PH-only hours



---



## How to Apply (follow this exactly — it's my first filter)



Applications that don't follow these steps get skipped. Applications that do move straight to a live interview.



1. Start your reply with the word **"HOMEOWNER"** so I know you read the whole post.

2. In 3–4 sentences, tell me about your **most relevant phone/appointment-setting experience** — what you sold or set, for what kind of business, and roughly how many dials/day you ran.

3. Record a **1–2 minute voice recording** (any format — Vocaroo link is fine) with **two parts**:



   - **Part A — read this exactly as you'd say it on a real call:** *

"Mr. Johnson, good afternoon to you, sir. This is [your name]… [John], how you doing today? So I'm calling from the office of the field underwriter assigned to your mortgage there — a while back you got a notice in the mail about mortgage protection. Is that ringing a bell?"*



   - **Part B — now stay in character:** I answer and say *"I don't really remember filling anything out."* Reactivate me and try to book me for a quick call this evening.



   Part A shows me your delivery and English on real script wording; Part B shows me how you think on the phone when someone pushes back. I want to hear both.



That voice sample matters more than your résumé. If you're good on the phone, I'll know in the first thirty seconds. **Strong applications will be invited to a quick WhatsApp interview.**

title: Junior Video Editor
description:
*** Please read the entire post before applying. Thanks! ***



*** About the Role ***



If you want editing work that actually matters, this is it!



Engage Video Production (EVP) creates educational and communication-focused video for aerospace, defense, and other technical clients. You will help turn complex subjects into something clear and usable, whether that means explaining how satellites stay in orbit, helping engineers communicate their work, or building training content people can actually follow. The work is structured and built for real-world use, not just visuals.



This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week role working directly with the Creative Director. Projects range from short explainers to long-form training content. Aerospace and defense are our core specialties, but our projects vary widely, so we need an editor who is adaptable, technically proficient, and comfortable shifting styles to fit each client's goals.



If you need reminders to respond or follow up, this is not a fit. If you spot issues early, communicate clearly, and take ownership of your work, keep reading.



*** The Three Pillars of Success at EVP ***



To succeed here, you need to live these three values:



Discipline: You follow through on every task without floundering or ghosting. You manage your time and meet deadlines without constant supervision.



Ownership / Initiative: You do more than complete tasks. You look for ways to improve the work and support the team.



Integrity / Accountability: You own your mistakes right away. You have the backbone to point out errors for correction, even your own, because precision here is non-negotiable.



*** Role Overview ***



You will execute the editing of active projects under the guidance of our Creative Director. Aside from syncs and updates to align on priorities, you work independently. You are responsible for your output, your timeline, and how you communicate progress.



The ideal candidate works independently on assigned tasks, manages large volumes of data, and communicates proactively. You take pride in technical accuracy and understand how a project's storytelling drives results for the client.



*** Core Responsibilities ***



Video Editing: Edit short- and long-form content from start to finish, with strong storytelling and pacing on every project.



Media Management: Organize, sync, and manage large volumes of footage. You must be comfortable with projects ranging from hundreds of gigabytes to multiple terabytes.



Technical Finishing: Perform professional color correction and grading on all deliverables, including RAW workflows, and keep visual consistency.



Audio and Sound Design: Integrate music, handle basic audio cleanup and mixing, and make sure sound design fits the project's goals.



Graphics: Apply motion graphics, titles, and lower thirds as the project requires, for a polished, professional product.



Feedback and Coordination: Implement revisions efficiently and meet agreed deadlines. You will coordinate daily with the Creative Director and, when applicable, other editors or freelancers.



Communication: This is part of the job, not an extra. Send progress updates as needed, flag blockers early and suggest solutions, and stay aligned with the Creative Director and company priorities. Silent work does not fly here.



*** Required Qualifications ***



Professional Background: Real experience in video editing (freelance or agency), with a solid grasp of pacing, storytelling, and professional delivery formats.



Software: Solid working proficiency in DaVinci Resolve or Adobe Premiere Pro. Resolve is our preferred NLE, but we welcome expert Premiere editors who deliver professional results.



Technical Foundations: Strong audio cleanup and mixing, plus color correction and grading workflows.



RAW Workflow (Preferred): Experience editing and grading RED RAW footage. If you have not handled RED RAW, you must be a fast learner who can manage complex, high-resolution media.



Data and Infrastructure: A reliable, high-speed internet connection is non-negotiable. You will regularly receive hundreds of gigabytes to terabytes of footage and must be comfortable managing that volume.



Autonomy and Communication: Excellent written English and a proactive approach to reporting. You work without micromanagement and stay vocal about timelines, challenges, and progress.



*** Bonus / Preferred Skills ***



- Motion graphics (Fusion, After Effects, or similar)

- Graphic design for diagrams or visual explainers

- Experience with technical, educational, or corporate content

- Familiarity with 
 or structured feedback workflows

- Interest in aerospace, defense, or technical subjects



*** Compensation ***



Hourly Rate: $4.00 to $8.00 USD per hour. Your starting rate depends on experience and demonstrated skill.

This is a full-time role and full-time is what we are after. That said, if you are clearly qualified but can only commit part-time right now, apply anyway and tell us your availability.



Full-Time (40 hrs/week): $640 to $1,280 USD per month (about 39,000 to 78,000 PHP).

Part-Time (20 hrs/week): $320 to $640 USD per month (about 20,000 to 39,000 PHP).

[*Conversions are approximate.]



*** A Note on AI and Judgment ***



At EVP, we use advanced tools every day. But this role requires real human judgment and radical integrity. We are hiring a human, not a prompt.



If you use AI to draft your personal responses in the "How to Apply" section, you fail the first test of this role: honesty. We want your real thoughts and your real personality so we can tell whether you fit our team. If your application has no genuine human voice, it will be discarded. Use AI to assist your workflow later. Do not use it to represent your character now.



*** How to Apply ***



Follow these steps exactly. Attention to detail is part of the job.



- Set your subject line to: "Passionate Video Editor - [Your Name]"

- Use a minimum of 7 apply points (AP).

- Provide a link to your best and most current editing work. Include anything you want to highlight, such as motion-graphics-heavy editing. No portfolio means no consideration.

- State the 10th word of our "Three Pillars" section.

- In exactly two sentences, describe your experience with RED RAW footage. If you have none, explain how you plan to handle the learning curve and hardware demands of high-resolution RAW media. Plain English only. No AI-generated fluff.

- Attach or link to your CV/resume in PDF format only.

- Want to stand out? Record a 60-second video (Loom or similar) introducing yourself. Tell me why you are the right pick and what interests you about aerospace and defense. Start the video by addressing me by name (Ryan). Applicants who include this video move to the top of the list.



Thanks for your time and genuine interest.

title: Senior Video Editor
description:
*** Please read the entire post before applying. Thanks! ***



*** About the Role ***



If you want editing work that actually matters, this is it!



Engage Video Production (EVP) creates educational and communication-focused video for aerospace, defense, and other technical clients. You will help turn complex subjects into something clear and usable, whether that means explaining how satellites stay in orbit, helping engineers communicate their work, or building training content people can actually follow. The work is structured and built for real-world use, not just visuals.



This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week role working directly with the Creative Director. Projects range from short explainers to long-form training content. Aerospace and defense are our core specialties, but our projects vary widely, so we need an editor who is adaptable, technically proficient, and comfortable shifting styles to fit each client's goals.



If you need reminders to respond or follow up, this is not a fit. If you spot issues early, communicate clearly, and take ownership of your work, keep reading.



*** The Three Pillars of Success at EVP ***



To succeed here, you need to live these three values:



Discipline: You follow through on every task without floundering or ghosting. You manage your time and meet deadlines without constant supervision.



Ownership / Initiative: You do more than complete tasks. You look for ways to improve the work and support the team.



Integrity / Accountability: You own your mistakes right away. You have the backbone to point out errors for correction, even your own, because precision here is non-negotiable.



*** Role Overview ***



You will execute the editing of active projects under the guidance of our Creative Director. Aside from syncs and updates to align on priorities, you work independently. You are responsible for your output, your timeline, and how you communicate progress.



The ideal candidate works independently on assigned tasks, manages large volumes of data, and communicates proactively. You take pride in technical accuracy and understand how a project's storytelling drives results for the client.



*** Core Responsibilities ***



Video Editing: Edit short- and long-form content from start to finish, with strong storytelling and pacing on every project.



Media Management: Organize, sync, and manage large volumes of footage. You must be comfortable with projects ranging from hundreds of gigabytes to multiple terabytes.



Technical Finishing: Perform professional color correction and grading on all deliverables, including RAW workflows, and keep visual consistency.



Audio and Sound Design: Integrate music, handle basic audio cleanup and mixing, and make sure sound design fits the project's goals.



Graphics: Apply motion graphics, titles, and lower thirds as the project requires, for a polished, professional product.



Feedback and Coordination: Implement revisions efficiently and meet agreed deadlines. You will coordinate daily with the Creative Director and, when applicable, other editors or freelancers.



Team Growth and Standards: Help grow our junior editors and improve how we work. You will share what you know, give clear feedback on their edits, and streamline our editing practices, templates, and workflows so the whole team moves faster and more consistently.



Communication: This is part of the job, not an extra. Send progress updates as needed, flag blockers early and suggest solutions, and stay aligned with the Creative Director and company priorities. Silent work does not fly here.



*** Required Qualifications ***



Professional Background: Real experience in video editing (freelance or agency), with a solid grasp of pacing, storytelling, and professional delivery formats.



Software: High proficiency in DaVinci Resolve or Adobe Premiere Pro. Resolve is our preferred NLE, but we welcome expert Premiere editors who deliver professional results.



Technical Foundations: Strong audio cleanup and mixing, plus color correction and grading workflows.



RAW Workflow (Required): Proven, hands-on experience editing and grading RED RAW footage. This is a senior role, so we expect you to own complex, high-resolution RAW workflows from day one.



Leadership and Process: You can mentor less-experienced editors, give clear and useful feedback, and tighten how the team works. You make the people and the process around you better, not just your own edits.



Data and Infrastructure: A reliable, high-speed internet connection is non-negotiable. You will regularly receive hundreds of gigabytes to terabytes of footage and must be comfortable managing that volume.



Autonomy and Communication: Excellent written English and a proactive approach to reporting. You work without micromanagement and stay vocal about timelines, challenges, and progress.



*** Bonus / Preferred Skills ***



- Motion graphics (Fusion, After Effects, or similar)

- Graphic design for diagrams or visual explainers

- Experience with technical, educational, or corporate content

- Familiarity with 
 or structured feedback workflows

- Interest in aerospace, defense, or technical subjects



*** Compensation ***



Hourly Rate: $8.00 to $15.00 USD per hour. Your starting rate depends on experience and demonstrated skill.

This is a full-time role and full-time is what we are after. That said, if you are clearly qualified but can only commit part-time right now, apply anyway and tell us your availability.



Full-Time (40 hrs/week): $1,280 to $2,400 USD per month (about 78,000 to 146,000 PHP).

Part-Time (20 hrs/week): $640 to $1,200 USD per month (about 39,000 to 73,000 PHP).

[*Conversions are approximate.]



*** A Note on AI and Judgment ***



At EVP, we use advanced tools every day. But this role requires real human judgment and radical integrity. We are hiring a human, not a prompt.



If you use AI to draft your personal responses in the "How to Apply" section, you fail the first test of this role: honesty. We want your real thoughts and your real personality so we can tell whether you fit our team. If your application has no genuine human voice, it will be discarded. Use AI to assist your workflow later. Do not use it to represent your character now.



*** How to Apply ***



Follow these steps exactly. Attention to detail is part of the job.



- Set your subject line to: "Passionate Video Editor - [Your Name]"

- Use a minimum of 7 apply points (AP).

- Provide a link to your best and most current editing work. Include anything you want to highlight, such as motion-graphics-heavy editing. No portfolio means no consideration.

- State the 10th word of our "Three Pillars" section.

- In exactly two sentences, describe your experience with RED RAW footage. If you have none, explain how you plan to handle the learning curve and hardware demands of high-resolution RAW media. Plain English only. No AI-generated fluff.

- Attach or link to your CV/resume in PDF format only.

- We expect senior applicants to record a 60-second video (Loom or similar) introducing yourself. It is not a hard requirement, but at this level skipping it is a missed opportunity. Tell me why you are the right pick and what interests you about aerospace and defense. Start the video by addressing me by name (Ryan). Applicants who include it move to the top of the list.



Thanks for your time and genuine interest.

About You



You are a capable, positive, adaptable professional who enjoys variety and working across multiple areas of a business. You take pride in being reliable, organised, and one step ahead.

- Clear, confident communication—both written and verbal.



- Proactive attitude with the ability to anticipate needs and solve problems.



- Competency with Microsoft Office and a willingness to learn new systems quickly.

- Highly Regarded

- Accounts, billing, or compliance experience.

Why Join ADVA Group?

title: Remote Quantity Surveyor – New Zealand Residential Construction
description:
We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented **Quantity Surveyor** to support our New Zealand-based construction and property development businesses.



Our work includes new residential homes, prefabricated and transportable buildings, renovations, relocations, minor dwellings and multi-property development projects. The successful applicant will assist with estimating, material take-offs, project cost planning, procurement comparisons and ongoing cost control.



This is a long-term remote position for someone who can work accurately, independently and communicate clearly.



## Key Responsibilities



* Prepare detailed material and labour take-offs from architectural and construction drawings.

* Produce bills of quantities, project estimates and construction budgets.

* Prepare preliminary cost plans for proposed property developments.

* Obtain and compare supplier and subcontractor quotations.

* Maintain current material pricing and supplier cost databases.

* Break projects into clear trade, material and construction stages.

* Review plans and specifications to identify missing information, inconsistencies and potential cost risks.

* Prepare budgets for renovations, new builds, relocatable homes and site works.

* Track actual project costs against budgets and report variances.

* Assess subcontractor quotations, progress claims and variations.

* Prepare pricing for client variations and additional work.

* Assist with construction cash-flow forecasts and project funding schedules.

* Prepare feasibility information, including construction costs, contingencies, finance costs and anticipated project margins.

* Identify potential cost savings and value-engineering opportunities.

* Maintain organised digital project records, estimates, quotations and supporting documentation.

* Assist management with other estimating, procurement and project administration tasks as required.



## Required Experience and Skills



* Previous experience as a Quantity Surveyor, Estimator or Construction Cost Planner.

* Strong experience with residential construction.

* Ability to accurately interpret architectural, structural and construction drawings.

* Strong knowledge of construction materials, trades and building methodology.

* Experience preparing detailed material take-offs and bills of quantities.

* Advanced Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills.

* Strong numerical, analytical and problem-solving ability.

* High level of accuracy and attention to detail.

* Clear written and spoken English.

* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

* Reliable internet connection and suitable home office environment.

* Able to work independently without constant supervision.



Experience in any of the following would be advantageous:



* New Zealand or Australian residential construction.

* New Zealand building terminology, standards and construction methods.

* Timber-framed residential buildings.

* Prefabricated, modular or transportable homes.

* Residential renovations and property development.

* CostX, Bluebeam, Planswift, Cubit, Buildxact, Procore or similar estimating software.

* Xero, project management software or construction accounting systems.

* Preparing lender-ready development budgets and cash-flow forecasts.

* Measuring earthworks, foundations, drainage, services and external site works.



The role may initially involve a combination of part-time and project-based work, with the opportunity to become a permanent full-time position.



Some availability during New Zealand working hours will be required for meetings and project discussions. The remaining working hours may be flexible, provided agreed deadlines are met.



Please include the following with your application:



1. A brief introduction explaining your relevant Quantity Surveying or estimating experience.

2. Details of your experience with residential construction.

3. The countries in which you have completed estimating or Quantity Surveying work.

4. The estimating and take-off software you use.

5. Examples of estimates, take-offs, bills of quantities or cost reports you have prepared, with confidential information removed.

6. Your preferred working hours and availability.







Applicants may be asked to complete a short paid estimating or material take-off exercise as part of the selection process.



Salary depending on experience, and reviewed at 3 months.

Our Standards

Our senior editors will help you learn our editing style, creative expectations, and production process so you can succeed as part of our team.

title: THE MARKETING GENIUS
description:
WANTED: The Marketing Genius 



Think... Scroll-Stopping Creator Meets Funnel-Building Machine



Let's be real for a second. Most marketing job ads want a "social media VA" who schedules posts and calls it a day. This is not that job.



At The Event Engineer, we help visionary entrepreneurs scale past the 7-figure mark by building world-class event systems. We don't do "average," and we don't do generic. We are growing fast, and right now, our founder, Lisa Barry, needs one person to own the entire marketing engine.



We are looking for a rare human who is a 50/50 split between a Brilliant Content Creator and a High-Converting Funnel Builder. If you can write a hook that stops thumbs, edit a Reel that gets shared, AND build the GHL funnel that turns those views into revenue... welcome home.



The Stack You'll Own (Your Playground):

Content That Converts: Reels, TikToks, Shorts, YouTube long-form, and our weekly Substack. You research the trends, write the hooks, direct the edits, and hit publish. Every piece sounds exactly like Lisa, never like a robot.

The Wednesday Drop: Our weekly
 newsletter, yours end to end. Written, designed, built, sent.

GoHighLevel (GHL): You'll build and optimize high-converting landing pages,
 campaigns, and sales funnels. Every page visually stunning, premium, and functional.

Claude (Your AI Bestie): We don't just use AI; we co-work with it. You'll use Claude for copywriting, strategy, and analysis. You are the pilot; Claude is your hyper-intelligent co-pilot. But if your output sounds like AI wrote it, it never gets published.

Canva & Video Editing: You'll look at our analytics, figure out a killer strategy, then actually bring it to life: scroll-stopping short-form videos, lead magnets, PDF guides, and design assets so clean our developer can drop them straight into pages.

The Community: You'll engage with our audience daily and answer comments and DMs in Lisa's voice, building real relationships, not just follower counts.



Who You Are:

An Autonomous Thinker: You don't need a manager breathing down your neck. You see a gap, you engineer a solution, and you execute it.

A Strategic Storyteller: You actually understand marketing psychology. You know why a video went viral or why a funnel converted, and you can repeat that success.

Design-Obsessed: If it looks cheap, it doesn't get published. Period.

A Numbers Person Too: You report on what worked with real data, not vibes.



Qualifications:

2 to 3+ years working with high-ticket coaches, creators, or agencies

Absolute mastery of GoHighLevel, ClickUp, and Canva

Next-level video editing skills (especially short-form Reels/TikToks)

Flawless English and a gift for "voice-matching" (you can write exactly how Lisa talks)

You know how to prompt Claude like an absolute pro to speed up your workflow



The Vibes & The Package:

Location: 100% Remote (Based in the Philippines ????????)

Hours: 9:00 AM to 5:00 P
lbourne time (Full-Time, matching Aussie hours!)

Pay: 1 Week Paid Trial + $1,250 AUD / month starting rate + performance-based growth opportunities as we scale the empire together



How to Apply (No Generic AI Copy-Pasters Allowed! This is IMPORTANT)

We want to see the real human behind the screen. If you send us a 100% ChatGPT-generated cover letter, it goes straight to the trash.



To apply, send us:

The Hook Test: Write us a 2 line hook about live events. Human voice only. This is your audition.

Your Portfolio: Your absolute best short-form video edits, designs, or copywriting assets.

DISC Profile: Attach a screenshot or PDF of your DISC results (we love knowing how your brain ticks!).

Subject Line: Make the
 subject line: "[Your Name] | The Marketing Genius"



Ready to build something iconic? Apply now!

title: Enterprise / Solution Architect
description:
Position Purpose

The Enterprise / Solution Architect will lead the technical architecture design of the Transactions Cleared on Immediate Basis (TCIB) Sandbox Environment. The role is responsible for translating the project objectives into a clear, scalable, secure and practical architecture that supports participant integration, API connectivity, environment separation, testing workflows, certification readiness and future expansion of the TCIB ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

The Enterprise / Solution Architect will:

Design the overall TCIB Sandbox technical architecture, including infrastructure, logical components, environment layers and system interfaces.

Define the sandbox infrastructure model, covering development, system integration testing, user acceptance testing and certification environments.

Develop the technical blueprint for secure participant connectivity to the sandbox environment.

Define API gateway requirements, integration layers, routing models, authentication mechanisms and participant access patterns.

Design the connectivity model for banks, fintechs, payment service providers, aggregators and other eligible participants. Ensure clear separation between the sandbox environment and the live TCIB production environment.

Define scalability, availability, resilience, performance and future expansion requirements.

Work with the ISO 20022, API testing, cybersecurity and governance specialists to ensure technical design alignment.

Support development of the Sandbox Design Document, Architecture Blueprint and Implementation Roadmap.

Participate in stakeholder validation workshops and explain the proposed architecture to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Expected Outputs:

Sandbox Architecture Blueprint

Infrastructure and Environment Model

API Gateway and Connectivity Design

Technical Design Inputs for the Sandbox Design Document

Architecture Assumptions, Risks and Dependencies

Implementation Architecture RecommendationsRequired Qualifications and Experience

Degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Digital Payments or related field.

At least 8–10 years’ experience in enterprise architecture, systems integration, payment systems architecture or digital financial services platforms.

Demonstrated experience designing secure, scalable and interoperable technology environments.

Knowledge of payment systems, APIs, cloud infrastructure, middleware, integration gateways and service-oriented or microservices architecture.

Experience with financial sector systems, regulated environments or payment infrastructure will be an advantage.

Key Competencies

Enterprise and solution architecture design

Payment system integration

API gateway and connectivity architecture

Infrastructure and environment planning

Systems thinking and technical documentation

Stakeholder communication and technical facilitation

title: Facebook ads campaigns launcher
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Hi there, and welcome to this job post!



We’re looking to hire an EXPERIENCED

This is **not an ad management or media-buying position**. You will not be responsible for optimizing campaigns, changing budgets, analyzing performance, or making independent decisions inside the ad account.



Your responsibility is to carefully launch new campaigns according to our internal SOPs, verify every detail, and make sure each campaign is created correctly without mistakes.



## WHO ARE WE?



We are an established dropshipping company that has been operating since 2020.



We mainly sell apparel and fashion products through several Shopify stores, with new products and advertising campaigns being launched every week.



We have clear systems, detailed SOPs, and an organized workflow between our product listing, creative, and advertising teams.



## THE ROLE



You will be responsible for taking approved products and launching their campaigns inside our
/Meta advertising accounts based on our exact instructions.



This is a highly sensitive role because you will receive access to important company advertising assets. We are looking for someone who is trustworthy, loyal, responsible, and extremely careful.



Every action must be reviewed and triple-checked before publishing.



### Main responsibilities:



* Launch new meta advertising campaigns according to our internal SOPs.

* Create campaigns, ad sets, and ads using the exact structure provided.

* Upload and organize the correct ad creatives, primary text, headlines, links, tracking information, and campaign settings.

* Confirm that the correct
 Page, Instagram account, pixel, website URL, country, budget, attribution settings, and optimization event are selected.

* Verify that every product is connected to the correct store, landing page, and advertising account.

* Carefully review all campaign settings before publishing.

* Triple-check every action to prevent incorrect budgets, links, creatives, targeting, or campaign structures.

* Record campaign and product information accurately in our spreadsheets.

* Follow our naming conventions and campaign organization systems exactly.

* Communicate immediately if any information is missing, unclear, or appears incorrect.

* Report completed launches to the team and provide the relevant campaign information.

* Maintain complete confidentiality regarding our stores, products, advertising accounts, campaigns, results, and internal systems.



You will **not** be expected to:



* Manage or optimize campaigns.

* Change budgets after campaigns are launched.

* Pause or restart campaigns unless specifically instructed.

* Analyze performance or make media-buying decisions.

* Edit existing campaigns without permission.

* Make independent changes inside the ad account.



Your role is to launch campaigns accurately, safely, and consistently based on the instructions provided.



## REQUIREMENTS



* Must have strong previous experience using
 Ads Manager and Meta Business Manager.

* Must understand
 campaign, ad set, and ad-level structures intimately.

* Must be comfortable working with multiple ad accounts,
 Pages, Instagram accounts, pixels, creatives, and website links.

* Must understand campaign objectives, optimization events, budgets, placements, attribution settings, and publishing workflows.

* Must have experience launching
 advertising campaigns for e-commerce products.

* Dropshipping or fashion e-commerce experience is strongly preferred.

* Must be extremely detail-oriented and careful.

* Must be able to follow SOPs exactly without skipping steps.

* Must be comfortable triple-checking every campaign before publishing.

or internal processes with anyone.

* Must communicate clearly in English.

* Must be available every day for approximately 1–2 hours, including weekends when launches are required.

* Must have the potential to take on additional hours and responsibilities in the future.

This is a high-trust position involving access to valuable company assets.



The selected applicant may be required to:

* Provide a valid LinkedIn profile or other professional profile.

* Provide references from previous employers or clients.

* Show proof of previous education, certifications, or employment.

* Attend a video interview.

* Sign a confidentiality and non-disclosure agreement.

* Use two-factor authentication and follow our account-security procedures.

The initial workload will be approximately **1–2 hours per day**.



You must be available every day and able to complete assigned launches within the agreed schedule.



There is strong potential for additional hours, responsibilities, and long-term growth if you prove to be reliable, accurate, and trustworthy.



We are looking for someone interested in a stable, long-term working relationship—not someone looking for a temporary side job.

title: ISO 20022 & Payment Messaging Specialist
description:
Position Purpose

The ISO 20022 & Payment Messaging Specialist will provide expert guidance on payment messaging standards, message validation, payment flows and interoperability requirements for the TCIB Sandbox Environment. The role ensures that the sandbox design supports standardized, reliable and compliant payment message exchange between participants and the TCIB infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities:

The ISO 20022 & Payment Messaging Specialist will:

Review TCIB messaging requirements and assess alignment with ISO 20022 or other applicable payment messaging standards.

Define payment message flows for participant testing, including initiation, validation, routing, response, exception and reconciliation messages.

Develop message validation requirements, including syntax validation, schema validation, business rule validation and error response handling.

Identify required message mappings, data elements, message structures and interoperability scenarios. Support the design of the Message Validation Engine within the sandbox architecture.

Define positive and negative message testing scenarios to validate participant readiness.

Work with the API Integration & Testing Specialist to develop test cases for message exchange and interoperability.

Advise on message versioning, message catalogues, schema management and standards governance.

Provide inputs into certification criteria relating to messaging compliance and interoperability.

Support stakeholder discussions on messaging standards and payment flow requirements.

Expected Outputs:

ISO 20022 Alignment Assessment

Payment Message Flow Documentation

Message Validation Requirements

Message Testing Scenarios

Message Standards and Schema Management Inputs

Interoperability Requirements for the Certification FrameworkRequired Qualifications and Experience

Degree or professional qualification in payments, banking systems, information systems, financial technology or related field.

At least 7–10 years’ experience in payment messaging, payment systems operations, payment infrastructure, ISO 20022, SWIFT, RTGS, ACH, instant payments or cross-border payments.

Strong knowledge of payment message formats, message validation, payment lifecycle flows and interoperability testing.

Experience in regional or cross-border payment systems will be an advantage.

Key Competencies

ISO 20022 payment messaging

Payment message validation

Payment flow design

Interoperability scenarios

Standards alignment

Technical documentation and stakeholder explanation

, and other follow-up activity

We are looking for someone who has done genuine B2B cold calling before.

title: AMAZON A+ GRAPHIC DESIGNER
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Amazon A+ Graphics Designer who knows the Amazon platform inside and out. This is not a general graphic design role. The ideal candidate is a visual expert who understands the Amazon content ecosystem, can navigate Seller Central and Vendor Central confidently, and can identify and fix errors in existing A+ content without hand-holding.



You will own the end-to-end production of Amazon creative assets, from A+ Content and product images to Brand Store design and catalog hygiene, across multiple client accounts in the TaskOn pod model.



Position Details

Role: Amazon A+ Graphics Designer

Employment Type: Full-Time, Remote

Experience Required: 2 to 3 years minimum in Amazon-specific graphic design

Primary Tools: Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign

Supplemental Tools: Canva (secondary use only)

Platform Knowledge: Amazon Seller Central and/or Vendor Central required



What We Are Looking For

Beyond technical skill, we are looking for someone who:

• Takes ownership and works independently without needing platform guidance or task-level supervision

• Has a sharp eye for detail and naturally catches errors, inconsistencies, and compliance issues before they become problems

• Is comfortable managing multiple client accounts simultaneously without letting quality slip

• Approaches Amazon content with a conversion mindset, not just an aesthetic one

• Communicates clearly when flagging issues and follows through without being followed up on

• Treats catalog hygiene and asset organization as part of the job, not an afterthought



Key Responsibilities

A+ Content Design and Production

• Design Basic and Premium A+ Content modules that meet Amazon specifications and conversion goals

• Build comparison charts, feature callouts, sizing guides, and lifestyle layouts tailored to each product category

• Optimize all modules for both mobile and desktop display

• Apply and maintain brand consistency across all creative for each client account

• Refresh and update existing A+ Content based on performance feedback, catalog changes, or brand updates



Content Audit and Error Detection

• Review existing A+ Content across client catalogs and flag issues: broken image links, outdated messaging, non-compliant modules, or formatting errors

• Identify A+ Content that has been suppressed or rejected and diagnose the root cause

• Proactively flag listings that are missing A+ Content or where content quality does not meet brand standards

• Document audit findings and prioritize updates based on traffic and revenue impact



Product Images

• Design main images that comply with Amazon standards (white background, product fills 85% of frame, correct resolution and file size)

• Create supplementary infographic images that highlight key product features, dimensions, and use cases

• Develop hero images and lifestyle compositions that improve click-through rate

• Perform post-production editing including background removal, color correction, and retouching



Brand Store Design and Maintenance

• Build and maintain Amazon Brand Stores using the Brand Store builder in Seller Central or Vendor Central

• Design store layouts that reflect brand identity while following Amazon's store guidelines

• Update store pages for seasonal campaigns, new product launches, or brand refreshes

• Ensure store pages are structured for discoverability and conversion



Catalog and Asset Management

• Upload and manage creative assets directly in Seller Central or Vendor Central

• Maintain organized asset libraries by client, ASIN, and content type

• Track module versions and keep a clear record of what is live on each listing

• Coordinate with the operations team to align design timelines with launch schedules



Advertising Creative Support

• Design Sponsored Brands banners, custom image ads, and Sponsored Display creatives

• Create video ad thumbnails and end cards as needed

• Align advertising creative with the visual language established in A+ Content and Brand Store assets



Tools and Platform

Primary design tools:

• Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign



Amazon platform (must navigate independently):

• Seller Central: A+ Content Manager, Brand Store builder, image upload, catalog management

• Vendor Central: A+ Content submission and content approval workflows

• Brand Registry tools and Amazon A+ Content guidelines



Supplemental tools:

• Canva (for quick edits or templated assets only)

• Google Drive or equivalent cloud storage for asset organization

• ClickUp or Asana for task and project tracking



Qualifications

• 2 to 3 years of experience specifically in Amazon graphic design (A+ Content, product images, Brand Store)

• Demonstrable portfolio of Amazon A+ Content and product listing creative

• Hands-on experience uploading and managing content in Seller Central or Vendor Central

• Strong eye for detail, especially in spotting errors, misalignments, or compliance issues in existing content

• Ability to manage multiple client accounts and concurrent projects without a drop in quality

• Solid understanding of eCommerce visual hierarchy and conversion-focused design

• Comfortable working remotely and independently within a pod-based team structure

• Can commit to work on an 8-hour shift + 1 hour lunch in a Pacific Standard Timezone from Monday to Friday.



About TaskOn eCommerce

TaskOn is a Klaviyo Master Platinum Partner and full-execution retention marketing agency serving 7 to 8 figure DTC brands across Amazon, Shopify, Klaviyo, Wayfair, and WooCommerce. We operate in a pod-based model where small, specialized teams own client relationships end to end. We do not advise and walk away. We execute. If you want to do real work on real brands at scale, this is the place.



To Apply: Submit your resume and a complete portfolio of your Amazon A+ Content work. To be considered, your application message must include the phrase "AMAZON ROCKS!" in your introduction. Applications without a portfolio or without this phrase will not be reviewed.

title: Creative Strategist — DTC Health Brand (Customer Research at the Core)
description:
We're a fast-growing DTC health and wellness brand in the US market. We're looking for one person to become the single most important voice in our marketing: the person who understands our customer better than anyone alive, and turns that understanding into creative that converts.

This is a strategist role, not a typist role. Yes, you'll write — ad scripts, VSLs, advertorials, landing pages. But writing is the output. The engine is something deeper: relentless, daily customer research. If you're the kind of person who's genuinely fascinated by what makes people tick — why they hesitate, what they're afraid of, the exact words they use to describe their problems — keep reading. This might be the role you've been waiting for.



The heart of the job: know our customer inside and out

This is the #1 responsibility, and everything else flows from it. Every single day, you research our customer. You never stop learning about them. You become our single source of truth on who they are.

That means knowing:



Their demographics — age, gender, location, income reality

Their pains — physical, emotional, and practical

Their objections — why they don't buy, what makes them skeptical

Their desires and fears — what they truly want, what they're afraid of losing

Their exact language — the real words they use to describe their own problems

Where they hang out, what they've tried before, and what let them down



You'll dig through customer reviews, competitor reviews, TikTok, Instagram, Reddit, X, Trustpilot, forums — anywhere our customer talks. Then you translate what you find into creative angles, positioning, and copy that actually lands.

This is not a side task. It is the foundation of the entire role. If you see research as a chore, this isn't for you. If you see it as detective work you'd happily do all day, we should talk.



Who our customer is

You'll be speaking to older women, roughly 55–70, in the US, often on a fixed income. They are deeply skeptical — they've tried dozens of supplements that promised the world and delivered nothing. We call it the "supplement graveyard."

They don't respond to hype, miracle claims, or exclamation marks. They respond to honesty, restraint, and credibility. Their real fears are about losing their independence as they age and simply wanting to feel like themselves again. Their daily frustrations are low energy, joint stiffness, and brain fog.

The tone that works with them is calm, respectful, understated — treating a smart woman who's been let down before like exactly that. If you can write to her without talking down to her or overpromising, you'll thrive here.



What you'll do



Daily deep customer research — becoming our in-house expert on who our customer is (the foundation of everything)

Decide creative angles and positioning for campaigns, based on that research

Write ad scripts, VSL scripts, advertorials, and landing page copy

Use AI tools to produce and refine creative efficiently (so your energy goes to thinking, not just typing)

Continuously deepen our understanding as the market and customer evolve

Work closely with me, the founder — I'll mentor and train you on our approach to direct-response and positioning



Who you are



Genuinely curious about people. You love figuring out what drives someone to buy — or not.

Strategic instinct over raw output. You have some copywriting or marketing experience, but what sets you apart is the ability to dig into a customer and pull out real insight — not just assemble words.

Eager to learn and grow. We'll invest in training you. You want that.

Understand (or can quickly learn) direct-response marketing and consumer psychology.

Strong English writing with the right tone — able to write calm, credible, non-hypey copy.

Self-directed. You show judgment and initiative. You don't need everything spelled out.

Bonus: experience with health/supplement/DTC brands; familiarity with buyer personas, awareness levels, funnel structure, and research methods.



The opportunity

This is a chance to grow into a genuine strategist alongside a founder who will invest in you. We start part-time and, for the right person, this becomes a long-term, central role. Starting pay is competitive and negotiable, with bonuses and higher pay as results come — as you prove you can move the needle, your earnings grow with the brand. We begin with a paid trial so we can both make sure it's a real fit.



How to apply (read carefully — this is the first test)

We're hiring for a role built on attention to detail and how you think. So the application is designed to show us both.

1. Start your application with the word "MAGNIFYING GLASS" so we know you read this fully. Applications without it won't be read.

2. No AI-written applications. We want to see how you think and write, in your own voice — not what ChatGPT produced. AI-generated applications are easy to spot and will be rejected immediately. Honest, human writing with personality beats polished AI every time.

3. Do this short research task (this matters more than your résumé):

Imagine you had to deeply understand a skeptical 60-year-old woman who's tried and been disappointed by many supplements. In your own words, walk us through how you'd go about understanding her — where you'd look, what you'd be trying to find out, and what kind of insights would tell you how to speak to her. A few honest paragraphs about your actual approach is worth far more than a list of your experience.

4. Then tell us briefly:



A little about your relevant experience (copywriting, marketing, research)

Why this kind of work appeals to you

Your available hours and your rate expectation



We read every application that follows these instructions. We're genuinely excited to find someone curious, sharp, and ready to grow. If that's you, we'd love to hear how you think.

title: GoHighLevel Expert — Automations, Tracking & Landing Pages (Part-Time, Long-Term)
description:
Hi, I'm Dylan. I run GTMflow, a growth marketing agency in Hong Kong. We run Meta ads for service businesses like clinics, education centers and professional services. Most of the leads we generate come through WhatsApp and appointment booking forms.



GoHighLevel is the center of everything we do. I need someone who knows it deeply — the person I hand a new client to and trust that everything behind the scenes gets built right and keeps working.



The work:



1. Build automations: follow-up messages, appointment reminders, lead routing, pipelines

2. Set up tracking properly: pixels, Meta CAPI, GTM — and check it actually works before launch

3. Tag every lead with where it came from (which ad, which page), and send booked appointments back to Meta and Google so the ads get smarter

4. Build landing pages in GHL. We give you the layout, the copy, and examples to match — you build it and make it look right

5. Connect tools with webhooks, Make, or Zapier when needed

6. When something breaks — a workflow stops sending, tracking goes quiet — you find out why and fix it



You won't need write copy, run ads, or talk to clients. We will do it. However, If you are highly proficient in these skills, it is a bonus and we will happily allocate that kind of work to you. 



How I work with people:



I mostly care about whether things work, not how many hours you keep. Transparency is important to us, as we want to collaborate, develop ideas, and make improvements together. When you build out a project, we expect a short Loom showing what you did, and we keep simple shared docs so the whole team does things one way. Got a better way? Propose it. We test it, and if it wins, it's the new standard with your name on it. What doesn't work here is quietly doing things your own way, in a black box. 



Pay: $8–15/hour. I'm looking for someone to grow with us for years, not someone looking for a quick gig.



To apply, start your message with the phrase "I LOVE GOHIGHLEVEL" ... so we can filter out the spam and the people serious about this role. Then send your response for the below:



1. A Loom (3–5 min) walking through a GHL automation system you built — show the real workflows on screen, not slides



2. A link to your best GHL page, plus one sentence: what were you given, and what did you decide yourself?



3. CAPI events are firing, but Events Manager shows deduplication failing. First two things you check?



4. A client wants to know which ad produced each booked appointment — not just each lead. How would you set that up in GHL?



If you answer all four questions, you'll hear back from me within 3 days.

Video Editor for AI UGC Meta Ads

We're a 6-figure DTC e-commerce brand running AI ads on
 and Instagram. We need an editor who can take a script and turn it into a scroll-stopping ad generating the AI UGC, voiceovers, and b-roll from scratch using our SOP and tools, then editing it all into a finished ad that converts.



What You'll Be Doing



- Editing 60–120 second AI UGC ads for Meta (mainly 9:16)

- Working with AI avatar footage (Capcut, Higgsfield, Flow, ElevenLabs, etc.) and syncing it cleanly with AI voiceovers

- Layering b-roll, product shots, and supporting visuals

- Following our scripts and timing direction beat-by-beat

- Adding text overlays, captions, hooks, and CTAs

- Light sound design and music selection

- Delivering polished, on-brand ads with minimal revisions



What You'll Receive From Us



- A finished script for every ad

- A detailed SOP walking you through our exact production process

- Brand guidelines and style references from our top-performing ads



You're handling the full production from script to final cut. We're handing you the system your job is to execute it cleanly and consistently.



What You Need



- Proven e-commerce / DTC ad editing experience (not vlogs, weddings, or music videos)

- Hands-on experience with AI UGC tools — (Capcut, Higgsfield, Flow, ElevenLabs, etc.)

- Comfortable generating AI avatars and voiceovers from scratch, not just editing pre-made footage

- Comfortable cleaning up AI avatar quirks (lip-sync drift, awkward pauses, robotic pacing) so the final product feels human

- Strong ability to follow a documented SOP without constant hand-holding

- Premiere Pro, CapCut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve proficiency

- 24–48 hour turnaround, consistent quality



Bonus Points



- Experience with ElevenLabs, Higgsfield, Flow, Kling, and other AI generation tools

- Ability to spot when an AI generation needs to be regenerated vs. salvaged

- A portfolio of e-commerce ads that have actually run (with results, if you have them)





Expectations



1. Send your resume with your application. No resume = no reply.

2. You must have DTC / e-commerce ad experience. Not vlogs or music videos.

3. You must have actually produced AI UGC ads before not just edited around AI footage someone else generated. Show us examples.

4. You must complete a paid trial before hiring. We send you a script, the SOP, and tool access. You produce one full ad end-to-end. Takes about 1–2 hours. Lets both of us see if it's a fit.



Standards



Our ads compete against the best in DTC. If your AI UGC looks stiff, robotic, or sloppy bad lip-sync, awkward cuts, dead pacing, or off-brand visuals this isn't the role. If you can take a script and an SOP and produce ads that feel native to the feed and convert, you're exactly who we want.



How to Apply



1. Resume with links to **AI UGC ads you've produced (required generic e-commerce ads aren't enough)

2. Which AI UGC tools you've worked with most

3. Timezone and weekly availability

4. If you've read this far, include the word "PINEAPPLE" in the opening line of the message you send me containing your resume

5. One line on what makes your AI UGC ads convert



No resume + no AI UGC portfolio = no interview.

title: Amazon FBA Wholesale Sourcing VA (ASIN ? Wholesale Supplier Research)
description:
# Amazon FBA Wholesale Sourcing VA (ASIN ? Wholesale Supplier Research)



**Pay:** $5/hour (Depending on experience)

**Hours:** 20 hours/week

**Location:** Remote



## Job Overview



We are looking for an experienced **Amazon FBA Wholesale Sourcing Virtual Assistant** to help us locate **authorized wholesale suppliers** for branded products.



We will provide you with **large lists of Amazon ASINs that are already ungated on our Amazon Seller account.** Your job is to identify legitimate wholesale sources where these exact products can be purchased profitably.



This is **NOT** a product research position.



We are **not** looking for:



* Private Label

* Online Arbitrage

* Retail Arbitrage

* Dropshipping

* eBay product research



If your experience is mainly finding products on Amazon without locating real wholesale suppliers, this position is not the right fit.



---



## Your Responsibilities



For each ASIN provided:



* Identify the exact branded product.

* Find legitimate wholesale suppliers, distributors, manufacturers, or authorized dealers.

* Verify the supplier is suitable for Amazon wholesale.

* Match supplier SKU/UPC to the correct Amazon ASIN.

* Record:



  * Supplier name

  * Product page

  * Wholesale price

  * MOQ (if applicable)

  * Case pack quantity

  * Supplier SKU

  * UPC

  * Brand

  * Contact information (if available)

* Calculate:



  * Estimated ROI

  * Profit

  * Margin

* Check:



  * Amazon on the listing

  * Number of FBA sellers

  * Sales Rank

  * Estimated monthly sales

  * Brand restrictions (if applicable)

* Flag products that are ready for test orders.



---



## Required Experience



You should have experience with:



* Amazon FBA Wholesale

* Seller Central

* Wholesale supplier research

* Distributor catalog matching

* UPC / SKU matching

* Keepa

* SellerAmp (SAS)

* RevSeller

* Google Sheets



Experience using wholesale directories and distributor websites is highly preferred.



---



## What We Will Provide



* Large lists of Amazon ASINs

* Clear sourcing criteria

* Google Sheets template

* Profit calculator

* Examples of completed work



---



## Deliverables



For every ASIN, provide:



* Amazon ASIN

* Product Name

* Brand

* Wholesale Supplier

* Supplier URL

* Wholesale Cost

* MOQ

* Case Quantity

* Supplier SKU

* UPC

* Estimated ROI

* Estimated Profit

* Match Confidence

* Notes



Accuracy is much more important than speed.



---



## To Apply



Please answer ALL of the following questions:



1. How many years have you worked specifically in Amazon FBA Wholesale?



2. What tools do you use for wholesale sourcing? (Keepa, SellerAmp, RevSeller, SmartScout, ScanUnlimited, etc.)



3. Describe your process for finding a wholesale supplier for an Amazon ASIN.



4. Have you ever matched distributor catalogs to Amazon listings? If yes, explain.



5. How many ASINs can you accurately source in one hour?



6. Please provide a sample Google Sheet (or screenshots) of previous sourcing work.



Applications without answers to these questions will not be considered.

title: Remote Data Analyst, Billing Auditor & Fleet Coordinator
description:
Remote Data Analyst, Billing Auditor & Fleet Coordinator (U.S. Field Service)

Job Type: Independent Contractor (Full-Time Seasonal with Full-Time Year-Round Potential)



Duration: ~20 weeks (Immediate start through mid-November)



Hours: 40 hours/week | U.S. EST Daytime Business Hours (Graveyard Shift in the Philippines)



Pay Rate: $8.00 – $10.00 USD / hour (Premium, top-tier market rate | Paid weekly via Wise or PayPal)



Target Location: Philippines



About Us

We are a fast-growing, family-owned lawn care company operating in the Delaware County / Philadelphia, USA market, managing a high volume of weekly accounts. Our field crews are completely mobile, receiving 100% of their daily routing and job assignments directly on their phones via our dispatch apps.



Let’s be completely clear: We know exactly how to win in our market. Our only bottleneck right now is that the owner is stuck in front of a computer instead of growing the business on the ground. We need an autonomous partner to lock down 100% of our internal office work so we can get back out into the field, expand our crews, and rinse-and-repeat the exact operational blueprint that made us successful to this point. Your success in the office directly fuels our growth on the street.



The Reality of the Role

This is not a high-level corporate strategy or corporate IT role. This is a high-volume, highly repetitive daily data verification position combined with independent historical data-mining.



Right now, the job is 95% boring, repeatable office work, and 5% high-impact data strategy. Your primary mission is to be our ultimate line of defense against lost revenue. You must love tracking details, matching numbers, cross-checking map data, and executing clean daily routines flawlessly without getting restless.



The Trade-Off & Life-Changing Career Path: We understand that this level of meticulous work requires intense focus and discipline. Because we are a family-owned business, we do not treat our team like numbers in a corporate system. We are intentionally offering a premium, top-market salary. In the Philippines remote market, this is a life-changing salary designed to provide you and your family with absolute financial security and long-term stability.



We budget for this stability intentionally. In exchange for changing your financial life and providing a permanent, year-round management home, we demand your absolute, 100% undivided dedication.



Because landscaping is a seasonal industry, your role will shift during the winter slow periods. Instead of daily crew routing, you will pivot completely to high-impact business development: taking full ownership of our local SEO (Search Engine Optimization), building out social media channels, and handling the digital marketing setups required to aggressively push our company's online presence up so we are fully loaded with fresh leads before the spring rush hits. If you hit your metrics and help grow our company, we intend to scale your compensation up even higher next year.



???? High Autonomy & Self-Sufficiency Required

We do not have a corporate training department, and the owner is active in the field running crews. We do not have time to explain basic data analysis, show you how to navigate standard software, or micro-manage your daily tasks. You must be completely self-sufficient. You are expected to jump into our platforms independently, figure out how the data pieces connect, actively hunt for historical revenue leaks, and bring solutions—not questions—to the table. If you require constant reassurance, step-by-step directions, or hand-holding to complete a project, this is not the role for you.



???? Strict Non-Negotiables (Anti-Job-Stacking Rules)

100% Exclusive Dedication: We are paying a premium wage specifically for your undivided attention. If you are looking for a casual role to "stack" alongside other freelance clients, or if you plan to juggle secondary contract work during your shift because of downtime, do not apply.



The Zero-Notice Phone Environment: Our crews are live on the ground facing real-time field emergencies. We operate in a zero-notice voice environment. If the owner calls you out of nowhere to adjust a route or handle an issue, you must be instantly reachable. If you are regularly unavailable, slow to respond, or muted because you are secretly managing other client tasks, your contract will be terminated immediately.



Daily & Strategic Responsibilities

Revenue Loss Auditing & Data Aggregation: You will independently dig backward through our platform history to aggregate performance data. Your goal is to map out operational gaps, identify underperforming pricing models, isolate local routes with high drive-time bleed, and present clear, data-driven strategies to the owner on how to correct these leaks and expand route density.



Photo & GPS Auditing: Before any invoice goes out, you will pull the work order, check the crew's GPS tracking pin, and stare at the crew-uploaded completion photos to verify the lawn was cut correctly. If the photo or location doesn't match the order, you stop it. You are the final shield for billing accuracy.



High-Volume Invoicing: Take full ownership of our daily billing cycle. Ensure all client invoices are accurately processed, matched, and sent out through our digital platforms on time, every single day.



Route Density & Map Optimization: Review incoming jobs from third-party platforms. Drop properties into satellite maps to measure dimensions, verify the payout viability, and ensure jobs are grouped tightly together to minimize our truck drive times.



Central Customer Communications: Handle day-to-day client text messages, platform chat queues, and support notifications professionally, responsively, and in flawless English.



Off-Season Growth & Digital Marketing (Winter Pivot): During the seasonal slow periods, you will take ownership of executing our digital growth strategies—improving local SEO rankings, managing social media content, and deploying internet marketing tactics to elevate our company's presence.



Process Documentation: We do not have a pre-written corporate training manual. You will live-shadow the owner on video calls, absorb the market logic, and write down the clean, repeatable checklists and SOP playbooks yourself.



Mandatory Workspace & Tech Requirements

Zero-Noise Workspace: You must have an isolated, private, and completely quiet dedicated home office workspace. There must be zero background noise (no family, neighborhood traffic, or animals) during your shift.



Audio Quality: A professional, noise-canceling USB headset with a crystal-clear microphone is mandatory.



Internet Infrastructure: A primary high-speed fiber internet connection (minimum 50 Mbps) with a direct Ethernet connection to your computer (no unstable Wi-Fi).



Power & Net Redundancy: A mandatory backup power source (UPS/generator) and a secondary backup internet source (pocket Wi-Fi/hotspot) to guarantee 100% uptime.



Requirements

Experience: 2+ years of experience in U.S. service dispatching, logistics tracking, billing auditing, medical claims QA, or high-volume administrative data matching.



Language: Flawless, natural, and highly polished spoken and written English.



Technical Skills: Highly proficient in data aggregation (advanced Google Sheets/Excel tracking, cross-referencing multi-platform history) and a proven ability to translate messy logs into actionable revenue-protection strategies. Familiarity with basic digital marketing concepts (SEO, local listing management, social media tools) is a massive plus.



Platform Knowledge: Hands-on experience navigating field service software, billing dashboards, or CRM tickets (Jobber, Housecall Pro, Service Autopilot, Salesforce, or similar queues) is highly preferred.



The Mindset: A proactive, self-starting investigator with a thick skin for handling high-volume daily tracking. You don't wait to be told what to do.



How to Apply

To filter out automated spam bots, agency placement groups, and casual job-stackers, we enforce a strict application process. Failure to follow these steps will result in immediate deletion.



Write the phrase "Ready to Route and Grow" at the very top of your application.



Attach your updated resume, specifically highlighting your experience with data aggregation, billing validation, or dispatching software.

title: QA Tester - Web App + iPhone Review
description:
Start your application with MANGO.



We need a part-time QA tester for Carby, a carb-conscious meal planning app. This role is for practical product QA, not generic design opinions.



Paid test assignment:

- Submit the test here: 

- First record a 3 minute web app tech check on a phone browser with microphone audio.

- Then record a separate iPhone app review if you have real iPhone access.

- Use the test web app URL: 
 and start from the beginning of the normal funnel. Do not skip directly to checkout.

- If checkout asks for payment, use Stripe test card
with any future expiry, any CVC, and any ZIP/postal code.

- Test in two modes: robot mode follows the exact normal flow; chaos mode tries to break real-user intent with realistic cases like in-app browser, old account, already subscribed account, app already installed, reinstall, slow connection, double taps, refresh, app switch, and kill/reopen.

- Focus on previously unknown, revenue-impacting issues that could hurt quiz completion, checkout trust, payment, activation, retention, meal-plan use, grocery-list use, or trust.

- Paywall clarity: do not answer whether you personally would buy. Narrate what you believe is happening: am I paying today, when will I be charged, how much, can I cancel, and what happens after I install?

- Paid handoff/sign-in is critical: after checkout/trial, test app install/open/sign-in/access. If possible, cover iOS Safari, Instagram browser, TikTok browser, already-installed app, and not-installed app. If a paid or trial user cannot activate, that is high impact because it can cause refunds and kill trust.

- Vague reports like 'it did not work' need exact screen/action, repro context, and session ID or account identifier if available. Vague failures with no session/account context are penalized.

- Include a Google Doc with repro steps, video links, severity, clear screen/action proof, and what confused you.

- Include one final answer: what is the single 
nt most likely to make a real user quit before getting a useful meal plan/grocery list?

- Include the word crispy in the severity section so we know you read the instructions.



Good reports focus on exact bottlenecks: the quiz step where a user would quit, the checkout trust issue that blocks payment, the app handoff/sign-in issue after checkout, or the first meal/grocery action that fails.

Bad reports are broad opinions, personal willingness-to-pay guesses, silent recordings, old portfolio samples, or minor polish with no metric impact.

Remote | Part-Time | Two US Small Businesses

We are not simply looking for someone to complete tasks.

We are looking for someone who believes what we believe.

At Rewired360 and Willow Creek Counseling, we believe healing changes lives. We believe clinicians deserve excellent education, meaningful support, and systems that allow them to serve others well. We believe clean, accurate books are part of that foundation — they let us make good decisions instead of guessing.

If you find genuine satisfaction in a reconciled account, in catching a discrepancy before it becomes a problem, and in being the quiet, dependable person behind the scenes who keeps things honest and organized — please apply.

About the Role

I own two small US-based LLCs — a coaching and consulting business (Rewired360) and a mental health counseling practice (Willow Creek Counseling). I need a reliable, detail-oriented bookkeeper to keep both sets of books clean, current, and organized every month in QuickBooks Online.

This is a long-term ongoing role, not a one-time cleanup project.

What You'll Do

•	Categorize and reconcile all transactions monthly in QuickBooks Online for both businesses

•	Reconcile all bank and credit card accounts monthly

•	Prepare a clean monthly P&L for each business

•	Flag uncategorized or unusual transactions right away — don't wait for me to find them

•	Track contractor payments for 1099 purposes

•	Support AGI projection tracking in coordination with my CPA

•	Communicate proactively if something looks off

Who You Are

You are someone who:

•	Has real, hands-on QuickBooks Online experience — this is not an entry-level bookkeeping role

•	Is dependable and treats deadlines and reconciliations as commitments, not suggestions

•	Notices what's off before being told, and says so

•	Keeps client financial information strictly confidential

•	Communicates clearly and early when something needs attention

•	Stays organized without needing to be micromanaged

•	Values honesty and accuracy over speed

Qualifications

•	QuickBooks Online certified or highly proficient — non-negotiable

•	Experience with US-based small business bookkeeping

•	Familiarity with Profit First a plus

•	Reliable internet and availability for brief check-ins during US business hours (Mountain Time)

•	Strong written and spoken English

What Success Looks Like

Within six months, you have become someone I can trust to close the books each month without me having to check behind you. You flag issues before I ask, you keep both sets of books audit-ready, and my CPA never has to chase down a missing category or an unreconciled account.

We aren't hiring someone to complete tasks. We're hiring someone to protect the financial foundation of two growing businesses.

A Note on Commitment

mber, not a short-term contractor. Please apply only if you want a stable, ongoing monthly role and can reliably commit to it for the foreseeable future. If you anticipate major changes to your availability in the next year, please wait for a future opening rather than applying now.

We are only considering seriously committed applicants. Integrity matters deeply to us — we're building a team of people who do what they say they'll do.



How to Apply

Also include your availability, time zone, and hourly rate.

 that skip the questions, don't begin with "Ledger," or send a generic copy-paste will not be considered.

title: Closer (Sales, SDR, VA, Virtual Assistent, Remote Appointment Setter)
description:
If you love the fitness world, thrive on conversation, and want to be rewarded every time you turn an interested lead into a paying member, keep reading.



About Us

We are building an exclusive, high-level community for top-tier sports, health, and wellness creators. We help fitness influencers and athletes scale their impact and their business.

We are currently looking for a driven, remote Community Setter to speak with inbound leads who have already booked a call with us, qualify them, and set them up for a closer to bring them into our ecosystem.



What You'll Do

Calling Booked Leads: Working through a daily list of inbound leads who have scheduled a call after expressing interest in our community.

Following the Script: Running each call through our proven script to build rapport, uncover the lead's goals, and qualify their fit.

Qualifying: Asking the right questions to confirm the lead is a genuine match before they're passed along.

Handing Off: Booking qualified leads onto our closers' calendars, with clear notes so the closer walks in fully briefed.

Tracking: Logging every call, outcome, and follow-up to keep a clean, accurate pipeline.

Hitting Targets: Meeting clear daily and weekly targets for calls made, leads qualified, and calls booked with closers.



Note: You are not closing the sale yourself and you are not managing creators once they join. Your singular focus is qualifying inbound leads and setting them up for the close.



What We Provide

A Ready-Made Script: A proven call script and objection-handling framework — you won't be improvising from scratch.

Warm Leads: Every lead you call has already booked the call themselves — no cold outreach.

Coaching: Regular call reviews and feedback to sharpen your delivery and your numbers.

Growth: A clear progression path into closing or senior team roles for top performers.



Pay and Progression

A fixed monthly base amount, plus

Commission on every sale closed from a call you qualified and set.

Motivated setters who consistently deliver well-qualified calls can build a strong, growing income stream. Exact details of the compensation structure and progression path will be explained during the interview process.



Who You Are (You're a fit if...)

Reliable & Honest: You show up, do the work, and communicate transparently.

Highly Motivated: You're a self-starter who loves the thrill of a good conversation and hitting targets.

Culturally Plugged In: You naturally consume fitness content and understand the world these creators live in.

Coachable, Not Robotic: You can run a script consistently while still sounding human and adapting to the person on the other end of the line.

Equipped: You have reliable internet, a working computer, and a quiet place to work.



Requirements

Strong written and spoken English.

Comfortable running back-to-back calls off a set schedule.

Consistent daily availability for scheduled calls and follow-ups.



How to Apply

Apply here: 
/t/6ni393yCWvus



This is a short form where we ask about your experience, your familiarity with the fitness space, and your expectations. If it looks like a potential fit on paper, we will reach out with the next steps for an interview!
